Nya prevented this by sending a rush of water, but it was not strong enough to stop her. Nya did Spinjitzu to attempt to stop Ultra Violet but was hit with a pole that Ultra Violet was using as a weapon. Ultra Violet then trapped Nya under a car, dislocating her shoulder. Ultra Violet nearly finished her but the others returned and hit Violet with the wagon that caused her to be sent through a wall, breaking her mask as well.

Lloyd asked if Nya was hurt and she replied that her shoulder was badly injured. As Ultra Violet tumbled after them, Nya wondered if she ever stayed down before the latter collapsed, but when they prepared to escape, more members of the Sons of Garmadon surrounded them and they wondered what to do.

Green Destiny[]

Nya, Lloyd and Dareth were surrounded and attacked by the Sons of Garmadon, even with a dislocated shoulder, Nya managed to kick away some bikers to help Lloyd and Dareth defend themselves the best they can, but they quickly started to get overpowered by the numerous S.O.G Members before they all heard what appeared to be a loud noise coming from the sky, surprising everyone. Fortunately, she saw a portal form in the sky and dragons appear. When the riders were revealed to be the ninja. Nya quickly contacted her brother to tell him that she hears him and Zane tracked the signal.

Nya was happy to see the others back and that they brought dragons to help. Nya watched as the ninja scared off the Sons of Garmadon with their dragons and was amazed to see Wu had as an adult and his new armor. When the four ninja landed, Nya immediately embraced Jay, happy to see him safely returned. Nya later helped her allies in attempting to take down the Colossus. She was further relieved to see that the other members of the Resistance had broken out of Kryptarium Prison and helped in chaining the Colossus which collapses.

Afterward, she helped in loading up the Sons of Garmadon in the police wagons and was soon happy to see Lloyd had regained his powers and defeated his father who had lost his own and had been arrested.

Several days later, she and the others began to clean up the destruction left by Garmadon before Wu, now reverted back to his old age, stopped them to tell them there was trouble. The ninja rush out to see that it was only the citizens who wanted to thank them for saving the city. As they celebrated, Nya called for Skylor, P.I.X.A.L., and Dareth to come up with them. She soon rested her head on Jay's shoulder, happy to have her boyfriend back.

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu

Tales from the Monastery of Spinjitzu[]

Master Class[]

Master Wu gives the ninja a review in Spinjitzu, teaching them to balance, conquering fear, focus, and teamwork.

During the lesson on balance, Nya was the most confident out of all the other ninja, balancing atop a long bamboo pole on a single leg without even flinching.

During the lesson in teamwork, the ninja were split into two teams for a sparring session, with Nya being partnered alongside Jay and Zane against Kai, Cole, and Lloyd. In the course of their sparring, Nya knocked Lloyd to the ground, though he would be helped up by Kai. As they continued to fight, all six ninja knocked into one of the monks painting the Monastery's new mural, spilling the painter's bowl of golden paint over Wu and Kai, leading for Wu to conclude the lesson, remarking sarcastically that they were literally golden.

Samurai X-Treme[]

In the late afternoon, Nya and Jay participated in a sparring match in the Monastery's courtyard. When Jay stated he wasn't going to go easy on her just because she was his girlfriend, Nya offered to make things more interesting with a wager: loser would do the dishes tonight! Once Jay accepted, the two began their match, with each displaying powerful demonstrations of their respective elements. Nya would prevail however with a powerful torrent of water that slammed Jay against the wall with the murals. Conceding his defeat, Jay then complimented Nya's fighting capabilities and remarked how he hadn't suffered such at beating at her hands since the time she moonlighted as Samurai X.

Turning to the mural that showcased her original mech, Nya laughed and remarked how she would have designed it differently had she made it today. While rattling off a long list of upgrades and functions, Nya envisioned herself taking this imagined design variant on a test run, saving a village from the hands of the Skulkin.

When night fell, the bell calling the ninja in for supper pierced Nya's thoughts, bringing her back to reality. As she and Jay then ran off into the Monastery, Nya reminded her boyfriend that he would be doing the dishes that night.

March of the Oni

March of the Oni[]

The Darkness Comes[]

After showing Kai, Jay, and Dareth her new kimono, Nya told them that Wu was in the courtyard looking at the murals. Suddenly, they saw Firstbourne crash and land near the mountain. They ran to her and saw Faith was also badly injured. They brought her inside the monastery to help her heal.

Faith mentioned that darkness swept over her home realm and that she barely escaped. Wu points out it might be the Onis' doing and the ninja head to the Bounty to prepare.

Once they arrived in the city, the ninja fought the darkness but to no avail, Nya pulled them back up to the Bounty. The ninja then went to Kryptarium after Lloyd told them Garmadon might help.

Into the Breach[]

Once the ninja were airborne again, they discussed if they could trust Garmadon. Meanwhile, he turned the engines off, and the Bounty started plummeting toward the ground. The ninja hung on until Zane got to the emission switch just in time.

Later, Zane then asked that everyone meet up at the bridge, where Garmadon proceeded to tell the ninja about how the Oni were able to enter Ninjago. They used the Realm Crystal and he would be able to go inside the dark cloud to destroy it due to being part Oni, but he would need a weapon. Lloyd then argued that they can't just let him have a weapon then let him walk away unsupervised. Since Lloyd was part Oni as well, he claimed would also survive the darkness and decided to go with him.

While Nya was piloting the Bounty, Jay approached her and tried to start a conversation. He mentioned that he wanted to ask her something but when Garmadon arrived, he decided to tell her later.

When they arrived at Borg Tower, the ninja handed Garmadon a sword, but he started attacking them to activate his powers. He jumped off, and Lloyd followed. After watching Lloyd on his headcam, they heard distress calls and tried to find the source. They flew off, while P.I.X.A.L. decided to stay behind in case the two needed assistance.

While trying to find the source, the ninja watched as Lloyd and Garmadon approach the Crystal. When The Omega attacked them, his headcam broke.

The Fall[]

The ninja found the source of the distress signal at the NGTV building. Jay and Cole went out to help the people, but once they were about to leave, Nya accidentally turned the thrusters the wrong way. This caused Cole's rope ladder to snap as the ninja watched him fall. Kai pushed Nya from the steering wheel to turn the ship around, but Zane convinced him otherwise.

They went to save P.I.X.A.L., Lloyd, and Garmadon as they ran out of fuel. The ninja told them Cole fell off the Bounty, and Nya blames herself despite Jay and Kai saying it was an accident. After Garmadon told them they were wasting time mourning, he showed them the Golden Master's armor. However, everyone was upset at him and started leaving.

Nya still blamed herself while Kai tried to reassure her by telling her she's the one that makes plans for the ninja. She then said they can go back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu to forge the armor's metal back into weapons. Despite Kai being hesitant, he agreed.

Endings[]

The ninja landed near the monastery and Wu and Misako went to see them. They told the two that Cole fell into the dark clouds and destroying the Realm Crystal did nothing. However, Garmadon showed them the Golden Armor and Nya explained they might have a chance if they reforge the Golden Weapons. After Kai was done, he gave the weapons to their respective ninja but had to give the Scythe of Quakes to Nya as Cole was supposedly gone. A monk then signals to the ninja that the Oni were here, and they prepare to fight.

The ninja began the fight them and were surprised to see Cole arrived. Nya then hands him his Scythe but they were overpowered and retreated into the monastery. They then watched as Jay asked Nya to be his Yang, to which she delightedly accepts. Lloyd then points out that they can try using the Tornado of Creation against the Oni.

However, they found Lloyd under a pile of debris and mourned. He suddenly woke up and the ninja were relieved. As a celebration, their allies visited the monastery and watched the ninja make a new mural with their handprints.

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu

Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu[]

Wasted True Potential[]

The ninja, sans Jay and Zane, watched as Cole beat Zane's high score in a game called Lava Zombies. The ninja sat in the hot tub, which turned out to be the Bell of Divinity. Infuriated, Wu chose to put the ninja to a test to see how long they could survive in the room with his chicken. They were able to trap the chicken, but Wu was unimpressed.

After complaining about the traps Wu set up, the ninja asked him what to do. He challenged them to a battle but were easily defeated. Once again, the chicken was released to punish them.

Questing for Quests[]

In a hot tub, the ninja thought about what villain they should battle. Nya pointed out that maybe they should fight crimes and do other heroic things instead of finding a villain. They eventually thought to help the police catch criminals.

Nya was also seen with the other ninja going around town trying to solve mysteries and crimes instead of the police but was disappointed to find nothing. They eventually returned to the monastery and heard about a pyramid in a far off desert in Ninjago that Clutch Powers was reluctant to explore and soon ventured to go there and look for a quest.

A Rocky Start[]

The ninja rushed around the monastery, packing to prepare for their quest. Before they headed off, P.I.X.A.L. introduced the ninja to the hangar bay. They quickly head off with the Land Bounty and two other vehicles.

In the Land Bounty, Zane informed the ninja about Beohernie, although Jay thought the people mispronounced his name and should be called "Bernie." Cole discovered an oasis to stop and have lunch. Zane continued to talk about the desert, and Cole left to get food, but the basket sank to the ground. The ninja rushed to their vehicles and were able to outrun Beohernie; however, it was at the cost of losing one of the key compartments the Land Bounty needs.

The Belly of the Beast[]

Nya and the others were trapped while Zane attempted to repair the Land Bounty, but it was impossible to escape without the component the beetle ate.

That night, Nya heard Zane say that the Bounty was useless without the component, and the only way to retrieve it was to go to the belly of the beast itself. He then got the idea that one of them had to be strapped to a rope and sent into the stomach of the beetle. They played a rock-paper-clamp tournament in order to decide who goes in, and Zane ended up being the winner.

The next morning, Zane went on the sand and was consumed by Beohernie. When Zane notified the ninja that he found the component, the ninja pulled him from Beohernie, but he resisted by pulling onto Cole's Dirt Bike. The force by Beohernie caused Cole to fall out of his vehicle and onto the sand where two more bugs began to attack, but they were repelled by the ninja. Eventually, Kai shot fireballs at Beohernie's belly which allowed Zane to escape the belly of the beast.

With the component recovered, the ninja were to escape the rock and outrun the other scarab beetles to their next destination, the Ancient Pyramid.

Boobytraps and How to Survive Them[]

The ninja tried to convince Clutch Powers but couldn't.. Clutch got a call from the Explorers Club. His membership was about to get revoked, so he helped. The ninja went past obstacles. Cole used his strength to lift a column. Later on, Jay tripped a cobweb and the ninja fell into spikes Kai destroyed with his fire.

They soon reached a room with a sliding puzzle on a wall. Jay and Nya accidentally freed Aspheera, by finishing the puzzle. Clutch flees, saying he will be asking for help. She steals Kai's power and traps Jay and the other ninja after she beats them with Spinjitzu.

Ninja vs Lava[]

Despite the rushing lava, the ninja were able to escape their prison; however, they were still chained to the wall. They started pulling the chains simultaneously and Jay succesfully broke his chain, which lead to him falling down onto the rising lava, pulling his teamates with him. Luckily Nya managed to lift all of them up, clutching onto another chain. She rocked the chain back and forth until they all savely landed on the ground. They quickly celebrated their escape and everyone ran into another direction, which pulled them back togther and reminded them that they were still chained. They went the way they came in before and reached a fallen column, which blocked their path, but Cole used his lava arms to lift the barrier allowing the other ninja to pass. As Cole was lifting the column up, Jay caught sight of lava approaching them and he immediately began running away from the lava. Not realizing they were still tied together, this caused a chain reaction, as Lloyd and Cole were pulled towards Jay causing Cole to drop the rock and nearly crushing Kai.

When they reached the spikes from before, they find supplies from Hageman which they needed to ascend the slope. As they began to ascent, Cole complained about Kai's weight, which caused him to lose his grip and the ninja to fall until Nya was able to grip the slope. Despite the setback, the ninja were able to reach the top.

The ninja reached outside the pyramid, but they realized they were surrounded by lava. When all hope seemed lost, P.I.X.A.L. arrived in the ShuriCopter and saved the ninja.

After the long ride, the ninja reached their vehicles and promised that they will be ready for Aspheera.

Snaketastrophy[]

Before Fred Finely is devoured by an Elemental Cobra, Nya and the other ninja saved him and defeated the Elemental Cobra before they decided to go to the Ninjago Museum of History.

Powerless[]

The ninja saved the Police Commissioner and his crew from the Elemental Cobras and headed off to the Museum without Kai.

Nya fought the Elemental Cobras while Lloyd fought Aspheera and ultimately lost to her. She then performed Spinjitzu against the ninja and successfully defeated them. Aspheera then used her staff to destroy parts of the roof and which caused the debris to fall on the ninja. After that, she reawoke the Pyro Vipers, who were still in their tombs and told them to follow her out of the museum, and left the Elemental Cobras, so they could finish the ninja off.

Before the Elemental Cobras destroyed the ninja, Jake came in to shield the ninja, but Kai caught up and rescued Jake out of trouble while he turned on the fire sprinklers to distract the Elemental Cobras and Zane finished them using his ice powers.

Ancient History[]

Lloyd, Zane, and Nya headed off to stop Aspheera by taking a shortcut using Zane's GPS system. After they arrived close to Aspheera, Zane headed off somewhere and promised to return.

Nya distracted Aspheera while Lloyd attempted to steal the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu. Ultimately, Lloyd failed and both were surrounded by Pyro Vipers. Luckily, Zane arrived in his Shuricopter and created an ice barrier, which gave Lloyd and Nya enough time to escape.

Under Siege[]

While Lloyd, Nya, and Zane were in Ninjago City looking for Aspheera, Cole notified them that she was on her way to the monastery. In addition, he told them to find Clutch Powers; which he believed knew the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu's whereabouts.

As Lloyd, Nya, and Zane arrived at the Ninjago City Hospital, Clutch Powers told them that the second scroll is at the Explorer's Club, but he refused to leave. When Nya pulled him from his bed, Clutch called the nurses who escorted the ninja away.

The Explorers Club[]

As Lloyd, Nya, and Zane entered The Explorers Club, they were welcomed by Cecil Putnam, and the trio explained that they needed the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu. Luckily for them, The Explorers Club possessed the scroll; however, the ninja needed a membership for the club. Since the ninja didn't have a membership, they were pushed out from the building.

The ninja tried again, but this time, they used Zane disguised as Clutch Powers. Once Zane entered the building, he was confronted by Putnam who tells Zane that his membership had been suspended and cannot obtain any artifacts.

After the two failed attempts, Nya decided to be bold by sneaking in the building and stealing the scroll. Lloyd and Zane followed up, and all three reached the rooftop. The trio then shut down a fan by using Lloyd's sword and Zane's ice to prevent it from moving, and made their way down the ventilator using a rope hook. Suddenly, the fan broke free, which caused the ninja to fall and crash into the middle of a meeting between Shippelton, Smythe, and Underhill. Lloyd tried to come up with an excuse by saying they were working on the air conditioning, but his sword came tumbling down. Shippelton knew he lied and called for security, which caused the ninja to flee into a room.

Luckily for them it was the room were they kept all the artifacts and Lloyd came across The Mirror of Fears, which showed his greatest fear; to become just like his father. For Nya, her greatest fear was just being a normal citizen with no powers, and for Zane, his greatest fear was purely being a machine with code, with no humanity left. While Lloyd talked to Zane, something crawled on Nya, which caused her to freak out and she threw the mysterious object onto Lloyd and Zane. Then, the door opened and the security guards tried to seize the ninja, but they were able to enter another room.

Zane realized they entered the entomology room prompting Nya to tell Lloyd to not touch anything, but Nya knocked down a glass containing Venomasicus Tigrus which happened to have the second-most painful stings. The ninja tried to outrun the sworn of wasps, but they were stopped by Cecil Putnam and his security forces; nevertheless, the wasps attacked them. Putnam was able to get away from the wasps and shot a blowdart at Zane, but it deflected off him and hit a glass holding Vastodectrus Venomous which happend to have the most painful stings. Amongst the chaos, Nya told Lloyd and Zane to regroup and they entered another room.

This time, Nya found the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, so they wrapped it up and exited the building, leaving everyone else inside The Explorers Club in disarray.

Vengeance is Mine![]

After the Pyro Vipers held half of the ninja, Wu, and P.I.X.A.L. hostage, Lloyd, Nya, and Zane arrived with the second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

A lengthy battle ensued with all the ninja (except Nya) having the chance to possess the Scroll when it fell into their hands. Eventually, Zane got the Scroll and freezed the Pyro Vipers. Before Zane was able to give back the Scroll to Wu, Aspheera's arm managed to get free and she attempted to zap Wu, but Zane saved his master by pushing Wu of the way, which caused him to be hit and be seemingly destroyed.

A Cold Goodbye[]

The ninja came running in after P.I.X.A.L. had a nightmare of losing Zane. Wu then told the ninja that Zane was alive; however, Wu won't let the ninja come save him, since its location was remote.

Despite this, Lloyd stole the Traveler's Tea and the ninja headed to the Hanger Bay where they spoted Wu holding the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu. A lengthy battle occured as both sides fought for the Traveler's Tea. This gave the ninja no choice, but to tie Wu up and place a mouthpiece over him. In the end, the ninja headed inside the Land Bounty while P.I.X.A.L. stood outside and zapped the vehicle into the Never-Realm.

The Never-Realm[]

The Land Bounty landed on a cliff, forcing the ninja to evacuate and during the process, Cole lost the Traveler's Tea. This caused an argument with Jay before Lloyd broke up the fight and suggested they head down the mountain to avoid freezing.

After hiking through frigid temperatures, the ninja finally made it to a forest where it still was cold. In addition, the ninja faced danger when they were approached by wolves. The ninja fleed from the danger, but Lloyd ran into a tree, which gave the wolves a chance to attack but in spite of that, the wolves headed off somewhere else. What the ninja didn't realized was that one of the wolves was frozen on top of a tree.

Following the unusual sight of wolves running away, the ninja stumbled upon some people who were also frozen. Nya was able to sense one of the victims heartbeat, which made them realize they were still alive. Nya then got a signal from the Titan Mech. Before they sought out to find the Mech, Jay believed they should help the people, but Lloyd and Nya stood their ground saying they should get more information before assisting the people.

After they followed the bleak signal for some time, the ninja ran into the wolves again, but this time they fought. They were able to hold their ground for some time until three mysterious people shot arrows at the wolves causing them to run away.

The ninja followed the people to a nearby village where they were greeted by Sorla. After both sides gave their introductions, Sorla threw a potion into the hearth fire, and they were able to find Zane's location which was the Ice Emperor's Castle. Sorla told them that Zane was most likely taken captive by the Ice Emperor and he was "lost." However, Lloyd believed Zane was strong and they would still come for him despite all the dangers she told them about. Sorla then warned them of General Vex who was out to get the ninja.

Fire Maker[]

When Sorla stated they had to protect the Fire, Nya helped the Ice Fishers build a fortress in order to defend against the Blizzard Warriors.

Despite their attempts to defend the Great Lake, Grimfax managed to wipe out the hearth fire, before the enemies retreated. This caused a lot of despair, as the Ice Fishers sat around the empty Fire, freezing in the winter night. Kai continued to blame himself for not having his Elemental Powers before trying once more. This time, he was able to create enough Fire, and the Ice Fishers chant "Fire Maker" due to his success.

An Unlikely Ally[]

While Cole repaired the roof, he wondered why Nya's powers wouldn't work on snow and ice. Nya felt offended and useless, and after she threw a snowball at Cole, they found Kai boasting about his Fire powers. She reprimanded him before turning his hammock over to get him off it, and storms off.

Sorla confronted her and asked what's wrong. She lamented the fact that Kai got his Elemental Powers back but she couldn't her's. Sorla tried to convince her otherwise, but she was still unable to move ice. Lloyd found her, and asked that she and the rest of the ninja protect the Great Lake while hewent to the Castle of Ice alone. Before he left, she gave him the device in case he got close to the Titan Mech.

The Message[]

After some children ran out of the main building in fear, Kai asked Cole what he did. He claimed to have told them about how Aspheera trapped Zane to the Never-Realm, and Nya asked if that was appropriate for them.

Meanwhile, Uthaug ran towards them to show the village he found a piece of Lloyd's gi and said that there were signs of a fight and an avalanche. The villagers and ninja were concerned and hoped he was safe.

The Traveler's Tree[]

Nya was first seen with Sorla trying control frozen water. She was unsuccessful at first but Sorla told her to try again but when Nya did, she got interrupted by Cole.

Later, Nya heared a roar coming from the mountain. Boma and Uthaug rush to tell them Cole was also on the mountain, prompting Jay and Nya to go after him while Kai stayed behind to protect the village.

Krag's Lament[]

Nya and Jay walked up the mountain. They were concerned when they heared Krag's roars. They found footprints that lead to a cave. They went in to investigate it, and when they heard Krag, they decided to attack. When Cole explained Krag is his friend, he introduced them to Krag. Cole allowed Krag come along with them down the mountain.

My Enemy, My Friend[]

Nya was snowboarding down the mountain along with Cole and Jay. Krag followed them down the mountain and they discusses on how they could make the Traveler's Tea. They were interrupted by a roar from a dragon and ran off to hide behind the ice. They saw the dragon head off for the village and ran after the dragon. However, they arrived too late and they found the village frozen. Nya saw Sorla frozen and started beating on the ice, frustrated and upset. Jay and Cole calmed her down and Kai suggested to find the Land Bounty to fix it up and use it to distract the Ice Emperor. In the end, Nya smiled, agreeing.

A Fragile Hope[]

Nya was searching for the Land Bounty with the rest of the ninja and Krag. Unfortunately, they got chased by Frost Wolves, but this eventually lead them to the Land Bounty. There, they scared off the wolves and worked to get the Land Bounty starting up. When the wolves returned, Nya was able to start up the Land Bounty and they used it to outrun the wolves.

Once and for All[]

Nya drove the Bounty towards the Ice Emperor's castle. When they were in sight of it, she told Kai to let the others know they were approaching. None of them noticed that they woke up Boreal when they passed by his resting spot. Eventually, Nya noticed something was approaching them fast and Kai decided to take care of it. Very soon, Boreal ripped away parts of the Bounty and chased down the ninja, putting all of their survival into Nya's hands. She saw an opportunity and drove the Bounty up a ledge. It cut into Boreal's throat and they tumbled down until they came to a stop, with the Bounty crushing Boreal unconscious.

Awakenings[]

After the ninja recovered from the chaos, Nya discovered that Boreal was entirely made out of ice. This lead Jay to believe that the Ice Emperor is an Elemental Master of Ice, just like Zane, but it suddenly Nya realized that the Ice Emperor was Zane. The ninja exchanged theories and questions that confirmed it, eventually Kai told them they had to warn Lloyd, but before they could do so, Boreal woke up. At first, they tried to escape but it was no of use, because Boreal could easily catch up to them. Kai was whipped into the air and Nya ran to check on him.

She found him unconscious and then saw Boreal going after her. She saw ice stalactites above him and tried to make the ice obey her. She succeeded and ice came down, burrowing Boreal, and Jay and Cole congratulated her. However, Boreal emerged out of the pile and Nya apologized for failing. Fortunately, her brother regained his Elemental Powers and melted Boreal. After their victory, they headed off to the castle to get Zane and Lloyd.

Nya, the rest of the ninja, and Krag arrived to find the realm returned to normal and embrace Lloyd and Zane. After spending many days in the Never-Realm, they decided to return to Ninjago. Eventually, they were able to get home and were greeted by an overjoyed Wu and P.I.X.A.L., who embraced them. In the end, they all waited for Cole and Lloyd to return.

Prime Empire Original Shorts

Prime Empire Original Shorts[]

Let's Dance[]

Nya and Jay bumped into each other at monastery and Nya suggested they do something together. Jay declined because he wanted to go to Benny's Arcade Emporium, but offered to something she wanted when he gets back. She cheered up and exclaimed she wanted to take dance lessons, to which he reluctantly agreed.

In the dance class, they started to dance, but Jay was more successful than her. He managed to impress the whole class and Vlad Tutu. Seeing Nya disappointed, Jay danced with her again.

After class was over, Nya said she wanted to do something Jay wanted in return. They go to the arcade and he lead her to a videogame called Dancy Pants, revealing how he got his talent. Lloyd then called him to tell him about the Mechanic's break-in at a warehouse, but the two delayed the mission to play the game first.

Upgrade[]

After the Mechanic got away, Jay and Nya arrived at the scene, and Lloyd questioned their whereabouts. Both of them lied about where they actually were.

Prime Empire

Prime Empire[]

Would You Like to Enter Prime Empire?[]

The Mechanic and his crew were caught by the ninja inside the old electronics warehouse. A fight for the motherboard ensued with The Mechanic running away from the scene. However, he was captured during a high-speed chase.

After The Mechanic was arrested, the ninja decided to investigate his headquarters. As they were looking around, Jay discoverd an old video game called Prime Empire and messed with it, while the rest of the ninja continued to explore.

The ninja entered another room and see mysterious logos all over the place. A monitor booted up behind some books and Zane pushed them aside to see it. the monitor questioned the ninja if they found the motherboard, and Zane responded typing in the keyboard. The monitor replied back, saying that Unagami was happy and to activate the game, then turned itself off. Lloyd then questioned on who Unagami was.

They headed back to tell Jay, but he mysteriously disappeared.

Dyer Island[]

Nya along with the rest of the ninja tried to figure out where Jay was. They then found out Prime Empire was on and realized Jay entered the game after finding a recording of him.

The ninja then interrogated The Mechanic but he refused to answer any questions. Lloyd was annoyed so he directed the Police Commissioner to send him to Kryptarium Prison. Zane then informed the group that Prime Empire was created by Milton Dyer, so they decided to search for him.

They all reached Dyer Island and encountered traps such as lasers and robot dogs. Bob the Intern then turned the security system off after his shower and allowed the ninja to enter. They asked Bob questions, although Bob thought they would come with answers about Milton Dyer's status. Furthermore, Bob told the ninja that Milton Dyer was seeking revenge after being fired which prompted the ninja to believe Milton Dyer was Unagami.

Level Thirteen[]

The ninja headed to Borg Tower to see the analysis Cyrus Borg ran on the Arcade Pod. They found out that the game was a host to over eight-hundred players and was controlled by Unagami. In order to rescue Jay, Cole began playing the game.

While Cole was playing, The Mechanic, Ultra Violet, Captain Soto, and a couple of other prisoners who escaped Kryptarium Prison, enter Borg Towers to find the Arcade Pod. When they arrived on the top floor, the rest of the ninja fought with the escaped prisoners. When Cole finished the game, the ninja were able to enter Prime Empire with Zane taking out the motherboard before leaving Borg Tower.

Meanwhile, Nya along with Kai, Cole, and Lloyd marveled at their surroundings, the marketplace.

Superstar Rockin' Jay[]

Nya and her friends continued to look for Jay inside Prime Empire until they were attacked by the Red Visors. He along with the rest of the ninja attempted to use Spinjitzu and their Elemental powers, but only ended up getting dizzy from spinning with no tornado forming around them and doing Jazz hands. As they ducked for cover. Nya then witnessed "Jay" fighting a Red Visor and called to her friends about this, who seemed to also see other Jays fighting. Confused on why there was more than one Jay, Cole explained that they were some of the people trapped inside the game and made their avatars look like Jay. When they spot drones coming, the Jays told them to follow as they double jumped to the rooftop. Cole told them what the double jump was and Kai told him that it made no sense, but went with it anyway as the drones followed them.

Being cornered by drones from all sides, the ninja and Jay Avatars fought the drones. The Jay Avatars were easily able to take them out, while the ninja struggled with one of their own. Following Jay's advice, they headed to an alleyway below after hearing a codename.

The ninja suddenly spotted three Red Visors up ahead. Lloyd, Nya, and Cole hid, but Kai, thinking the game had unlimited lives, stood in the open and taunted the Red Visors. The Red Visors killed him and the ninja defeated the Red Visors with the help of his distraction. Kai re-spawns and expressed how much he liked the ability of "infinite lives". Cole tried to tell him how lives in a video game really worked, but Kai ignored him as they moved on.

Arriving at the location, which was an empty parking lot, the ninja were confused by the turn of events; Kai concluded that the Jay avatars were crazy since they love Jay so much when a masked stranger suddenly held them at gunpoint. Nya told him the code name the Jay Avatars mentioned earlier and the man invited the ninja inside his hidden garage.

The man revealed his name to be Scott and what he's been doing in Prime Empire. Kai accidentally killed himself by touching one of Scott's belongings; That being explosive. Upon re-spawning, Kai told Scott how cool it was to have infinite lives. Scott denied this and showed him his health board, which was down to one. Kai got mad at his friends for not saying anything and Cole responded by saying he did try helphim, but he didn't want to hear anything.

Scott then showed them to a secret room where the rest of the League of Jay was. That's when Superstar Rockin' Jay appeared and greeted the ninja.

I am Okino[]

Nya and the other ninja Jay entered Terra Karana after learning that the Purple Key-Tana was located there. The ninja then saw a depressed Okino and honor him if he could guide them through Terra Karana.

The Glitch[]

Nya and the rest of the ninja headed out with Okino into the Forest of Discontent. Their first obstacles were bushes which contained the Thorns of Discontent. Nya decided to take one of the bushes as he easily destroyed it.

As they continued walking, Nya then asked if what Okino had said earlier was true; The Key-Tana being in a maze. Okino confirmed this as a yes, as it was to be guarded by a dragon. Lloyd questioned on how this was going to be a problem, as they have all faced dragons before. Okino denied this and told them how strong this one really was.

At some point, Nya accidentally jumped into a pit. She then began to sink into it as teeth surrounded her. Jay and Cole attempted to pull her out in vain and Nya screamed as the sand and teeth swallow her. respawning, Nya was upset as well to see that she had also lost a life. Questioning what that was, Okino explained to Lloyd that it had been Swampteeth and reminiscenced what he had said earlier about the ground.

Okino and the ninja eventually reached a point where he tought the upcoming obstacle could be Strangler Vines. Lloyd found out it's not, but they were ambushed by the Whack Rats. The ninja defeated the Whack Rats and Ritchie was tied up. They interrogated him and Ritchie revealed that Unagami had ordered them to ambush the ninja. Lloyd then commented about Unagami preventing the ninja from winning the game which confused Okino. The ninja then explained that Prime Empire was not a real-world and Unagami was the creator of the world. Originally, Okino didn't believe it causing Jay to think that he had not been programmed to understand the truth.

Realizing Unagami was playing dirty, the ninja were about to leave, but Ritchie urged the ninja to cut him down because he had an itch. Ritchie then told the ninja that there was a glitch in the game that could allow the ninja to bypass the Forest of Discontent. The ninja ended up letting Ritchie down and he began scratching his body.

Ritchie guided the ninja to the glitch and he jumped in. Okino was confused at the sight as the rest of the ninja entered as well. The ninja were teleported to a purple cubed room. They walked forward and all of a sudden, the Red Visors appeared and began shooting the ninja. The ninja pulled out their prime controllers to defend themselves as Ritchie looked on before leaving the room. The ninja began to lose lives until Okino entered and fought the Red Visors allowing the ninja a chance to escape. Everyone but Lloyd were able to escape because Lloyd wanted Okino to come along. Okino decided to stay with Lloyd as he pushed him through the portal.

The ninja and Okino landed outside the Forest of Discontent. Lloyd thanked Okino, but he was kneeling realizing the world he lived in was not real. Okino thought that he was a pawn, but Lloyd downplayed the idea as he told Okino that he had made his own decision, not Unagami. Lloyd then told Okino to trust in himself and in the ninja as friends and as an ally to help them get past Terra Karana.

The Cliffs of Hysteria[]

As Nya is walking to Shifty's shop, he compliments her and calls her "Flower Nya" much to her dislike of the name. When Shifty lists the Rope of Supreme Durability, Jay freaks out and refuses to buy the Rope of Questionable Integrity causing Nya to calm down Jay. Shifty then sees a drone in the area and talks about Sushimi which confuses Nya.

After the Red Visors appear, Nya and the ninja begin climbing the Cliffs of Hysteria. She uses her prime controllers to defend herself and is able to reach the top. Lloyd was also able to reach the top and brings with him a Red Visor. Nya begins tampering with its controls and begins asking questions about Unagami.

The Maze of the Red Dragon[]

The ninja and Okino begin dashing through traps and just before Cole asks Okino where to go, Unagami pauses the game to speak with Okino. The ninja ask again when the game was unpaused and Okino leads them once more.

They make it to where the Red Dragon was and the Purple Key-Tana. Jay attempts to steal it when the dragon was sleeping, but the ninja accidentally awaken it when they save Jay. Nya and the ninja struggle to attack the Red Dragon until Okino strikes the dragon on its weak spot. The ninja begin striking that same point until Jay grabs the Key-Tana and takes out the remaining lives.

One Step Forward, Two Steps Back[]

Jay introduces Terra Technica to Nya and the other ninja and they decide to sign up for the Speedway Five-Billion. Unfortunately, they don't have enough credits to enter the race and to make matters worse, they were surrounded by Red Visors. Jay fights one of them and was forced to have a weapon upgrade which causes them to need more credits once they were done fighting. They then see an advertisement for a dance competition and decide to enter in order to obtain more credits.

Jay and Nya begin dancing and rank up points rapidly. This impresses the rest of the ninja as they didn't realize Jay was an excellent dancer. As Jay was dancing, he sees another couple dancing well and feels like they won't catch up, but Nya claims they have what they don't have, chemistry.

Both Nya and Jay realize that their rivals the blue haired couple were cheating their way to victory when one of them shoves another couple out of the game and kicks Nya in the heel, making them both realize they were cheating to win. The Red Visors then show up and begin interfering with the competition although Nya uses it to her advantage.

Jay and Nya see only thirty seconds remaining, more Red Visors were approaching, and the other dancers were ahead of them by at least one-thousands points. Knowing that in order to win, they must perform a big dance move, Nya jumps at the Red Visors and kicks them away, telling Jay to catch her. Jay panics, knowing that they never performed that move. Nya denies this and says that she trusts him, as she runs at him. Jay then tosses Nya in the air, spinning her around until Jay holds her up by the foot, then throws her back up. As she spins again, Jay then catches Nya by the hands while she was upside down and they spin, tripling their points. As they perform the move, Jay happily announces his love for Nya, again, and she smiles at him.

After winning the competition, Jay and Nya cash out their earnings to enter the race. The Ninja then realize they need cars, but Jay claims he knows someone who can lend them cars, so they head out to Scott.

Racer Seven[]

Scott shows the ninja all of the vehicles he had and commented that he wouldn't race due to having only one life left. Jay replies by saying that some things were worth fighting for, but Scott doesn't want to be a hero. Jay then explains that Scott had been in the game for way too long.

While Lloyd heads out to check out the track, the rest of the ninja begin making repairs to their vehicles. While Nya was working on her car, she falls down and Jay checks to see if she's okay. Nya then gets upset that her vehicle was now destroyed, but Lloyd comes back telling the team that he thinks Racer Seven can drive. However, Scott reveals that Racer Seven was programmed to lose which gets affection from Jay and Nya. Lloyd then goes out to find her.

After a grueling day, the ninja rebuild four vehicles but still need another one. That's when Racer Seven arrives, so the ninja and Scott come out to greet her. Lloyd then asks if she will participate or not.

The Speedway Five-Billion[]

While the ninja were talking to Racer Seven, the alarm sounds as Red Visors begin shooting the base. Lloyd said he would hold them off, but the ninja won't let him, so Scott decides to hold off the Red Visors. The ninja were able to escape, but Jay cries out when Scott was cubed.

The ninja were able to enter the race. After Cole and Kai decide to sacrifice themselves, Jay and Nya scream for their friends while Lloyd hangs his head down in despair while Unagami's drones pick up the cubes.

The Whack Rats then attempt to move Racer Seven out of first, but the ninja get in their way. Racer Seven crosses the finish line first and wins as everyone cheers.

Jay, Nya, Lloyd, and Racer Seven were the crowned the winners of the race and handed the Yellow Key-Tana. Seven hands it to Jay, as he states that they can make Unagami bring their friends back. They just have to get the Orange Key-Tana and confront him. Red Visors begin to appear again and Seven tells them she can handle this. The remaining ninja run away as the Red Visors confront Racer Seven and asks where they were. Seven plays dumb and they claim Unagami will find the ninja. Seven denies this and says that the ninja will be going after Unagami instead.

Stop, Drop and Side Scroll[]

The remaining ninja - Lloyd, Nya, Jay - head through Terra Technica and sneak past Red Visors. As they move, they watched of replay Kai and Cole being cubed from the Speedway Five-Billion, discouraging them. Lloyd tells the two of them that Kai and Cole would want them to keep on moving, which they do so. Jay shows them to the last Arcade Pod that would take them to the next area, Terra Domina.

When arriving, they find themselves in a side-scrolling platform, where they have to beat all the levels to reach the end. Jay describes how this works: As they keep moving, the ground will disappear behind them and will go faster as they progress, as they keep moving they will need to dodge objects and falling bricks if one of them dies, they all have to start over. As Nya questions the last rule, she is hit by a giant swinging sledgehammer with spikes, killing her.

The trio respawn back at the beginning, with Nya on her last life. Lloyd expresses his annoyance about having to repeat that again. Jay tells them if they pay attention, they can do this. As they get farther, Jay passes three of the same hammers that killed Nya earlier. As he flosses in his victory, he barley evades a falling brick. As he laughs at the brick, another one falls and crushes him.

They respawn back at the start again, now with Jay standing on his last life. They move on again and Lloyd gets blocked by a giant wall. He tries to double jump over it but doesn't have enough room to get high enough. Instead, he hits the wall and falls to his death.

The three respawn back at the beginning once more, now with all of them down to one life. Jay tells them that they can't afford any more mistakes. This time, they make it through the first section.

The music gets faster and Jay realizes this as the game was getting harder. They were then greeted by an infinity maze going upwards and the floor slowly disappearing beneath them. They travel upwards and after a while, they slowly get tired. Just as they think the side-scroller is endless, Nya gets a Loot-Box and unlocks the ability to perform Airjitzu. Jay and Lloyd tell Nya to go on without them but says for them to grab and hold tight and flies up to the top.

When they arrive at the top, they find themselves having to choose a champion to face their most dreaded challenger and obtain the Orange Key-Tana. Lloyd was chosen and walks in the fighting arena. Unagami chooses and spawns Lloyd's most dreaded challenger, which was Harumi, which surprises Lloyd. Jay and Nya try to warn him of what Unagami was doing, but a dome blocks them from entering the arena and mutes their voices from the inside.

Jay and Nya obtain the Orange Key-Tana, but they lose Lloyd as he's cubed. Jay then tells Nya that they will stop Unagami and finish it for those who were lost.

The Temple of Madness[]

Jay and Nya arrive at the Temple of Madness, passing through conveyor belts of shurikens while hand in hand, using skills they previously learned in their dance lessons to guide them through. They successfully make it through without losing any lives, despite a glitch occurring on one shuriken that was unpredictable.

Jay thinks the next level will be more challenging than the previous, as this was normally what video games do when the player progresses, but they end up at Sushimi's Sushi Restaurant. Thinking it’s a provided time to recharge, Jay and Nya take a seat, however, their waitress turns against them, making them realize it’s actually an attack. She throws knives and Monster Sushi at Jay and Nya, but they evade her attacks and defeat her. The Monster Sushi attack Jay, but Nya helps him shake them off.

Three red sushi chefs enter the room and begin throwing dishes and knives at Jay and Nya. Jay and Nya flip and push the tables in front of them as shields. They take out two of the chefs before having to deal with the pieces of Monster Sushi again. Jay and Nya defeat two of the chefs, but the third summons Sushimi, the Mad Sushi Chef. Jay and Sushimi fight with Sushimi’s weapon of choice, Chopsticks, but realizing they had to defeat him quicker, throw Monster Sushi on Sushimi’s face. Jay throws him on the conveyer belt and Nya turns it on, sending the chef flying across the room and opening the door to a staircase leading to a firewall, the last thing between them and Unagami.

Jay and Nya hug, but unexpectedly Sushimi had walked up the staircase and throws a malice at the couple. Nya sees him and quickly pushes Jay away, but was killed and cubed in the process. Jay, enraged, throws the malice back at Sushimi, destroying him.

In despair, Jay breaks down over Nya's death, saying he couldn't do this alone. Unagami tells Jay to surrender or suffer the same fate. Jay refuses and switches the Key-Tanas, closing down the firewall. Before leaving, Jay tells Nya's energy cube that he'll set things right and runs off to face Unagami.

Game Over[]

Nya was seen walking out the Manifestation Gate along with the other ninja and the trapped players and was happily reunited with Jay.

Master of the Mountain

Master of the Mountain[]

Shintaro[]

Nya and Jay were raking leaves until Jay decides to use Spinjtizu although Nya advises not to do it. When Jay was finished, Wu was buried underneath and doesn't say a word as he heads back inside.

Nya and the rest of the ninja get excited when they received an invitation to the Kingdom of Shintaro. Later, Nya and the ninja head to the Ivory City via the Destiny's Bounty. However, they encounter the Dire Bats. One of the Dire Bats swipes Nya and corners her, but Lloyd jumps on the bat and he flees. However, the Bounty still descends after one of the Dire Bats runs into the pole containing the sail. Although all hope seemed lost, the Army of Shintaro carry the ship while Hailmar greets the ninja and shows them the Kingdom of Shintaro on the horizon.

Into the Dark[]

Nya and the ninja were marvel at the beauty of the Ivory City and escorted inside the throne room where they meet King Vangelis and Princess Vania.

During the night, Cole wakes up everyone and tells the ninja about encountering a purple monster that contained his mother's necklace. However, Nya and the ninja think Cole was dreaming and tell him to go back to sleep.

The Worst Rescue Ever[]

Nya and the other ninja were strolling through the magnificent gardens, and realize that Cole was missing.

Suddenly, Princess Vania appears from out of a tunnel in a frenzy, telling the ninja that she went into the Dungeons with Cole and found an underground mine filled with little creatures being forced to mine by black skeletons. Cole stayed behind to rescue them and told her to get help.

The seven of them go to tell King Vangelis, and he was angry at his daughter for disobeying his orders, endangering their guests. He says that he'll send his guards down at once to find Cole, but he will not allow the ninja to go. The ninja realize that the creature that Cole saw in his bedroom was real all along.

The ninja leave the throne room and make secret plans to enter the dungeons behind the King's orders. Vania agrees to show them the way into the dungeons, and she leads the way back to the garden.

Wu agrees to stay behind with Vania, feeling as though he'll slow the rest of them down. The ninja enter the cave and find that Vania was telling the truth. Zane detects simple weapons and crude fortifications from the skeletons, and the others suggest that they bust up the bags of bones, and rescue Cole nice and quickly.

They all agree, and steal the keys to Cole's cage, and free him at last. In order to delay their capture, Zane blocks an entrance off for the skeletons with his shuriken. Cole tells them to keep the volume down, as there's a winged masked man who lives in the temple in the center.

The two tribes of creatures that live in the dungeons, the Geckles and Munce, start to quarrel with each other, causing a ruckus. This alerts the Awakened Warriors, who begin to attack the ninja. Lloyd orders Jay and Nya to take our the warriors, while the rest of them run away. The ninja the others were in shock, watching the Geckles and Munce call each other "blade stealers." Meanwhile, the ninja find that the Awakened Warriors go down without much trouble.

While trying to defend themselves, Zane realizes that his Elemental Powers were no use in the dungeons.

All the commotion causes the masked man to exit his temple. The man reveals himself as the Skull Sorcerer, a masked man in a black gown with wings, wielding a glowing green skull. The Skull Sorcerer uses the green skull in his hand to awaken the black skeletons around him, overwhelming the ninja, leading to their defeat and eventual capture.

The Two Blades[]

Nya and the other ninja were put to work by the Awakened Warriors, forced to mine heaping amounts of Vengestone, which explains their inability to use their powers.

After causing a ruckus, they werelocked up in a cage with several Geckles. When Gliff picks a fight with Murt, the ninja begin to wonder where their feud started.

Gliff explains that long ago, a hero named "Gilly" (who the Munce argues was named "Milly,") entered the mountain with two blades to defend the Geckles and Munce from a terrible dragon known as Grief-Bringer (who the Munce argues was called "Mief-Bringer.") After defeating the dragon, "Gilly" left behind her blades as gifts to the Geckles and Munce — leaving the Ivory Blade of Deliverance to the Geckles, and the Shadow Blade of Deliverance to the Munce.

The two tribe's feud started when the Munce apparently stole their blade, however, the Munce argues that the Geckles were the ones that stole the blade. The ninja come to the conclusion that it was actually the Skull Sorcerer who stole both blades, in order to get control over both tribes. While the tribes fight over themselves, they can't fight the Skull Sorcerer.

Lloyd puts together a plan to get the two tribes to make a truce so they can all break out. Word was passed around through Geckles and Munce about a secret meeting after lunch, and when the time comes, they discuss retrieving both Blades by defeating the Skull Sorcerer.

Later, the ninja break out of their cages by getting a Minos to eat through their chains. The ninja split up, while Cole and Lloyd attempt to find the two blades, Zane and the others go about releasing the remaining Geckles and Munce. A few minutes later, chaos ensues, as Cole and Lloyd were chased away by the Skull Sorcerer.

In the commotion, the ninja were split up so that Jay, Nya, and Lloyd go one path, while Zane and Kai go down another. Cole was further separated from the group as he was chased by the Skull Sorcerer.

Queen of the Munce[]

Jay, Nya, and Lloyd follow the Munce to their home; however, Murt cannot remember where to go. Feeling like they'll never escape the tunnel, Jay begins to moan, but Nya finds footprints and they follow the tracks. Jay quickly changes his attitude saying he was always optimistic which earns a stern look from the others.

The ninja, including Jay, were introduced to Queen Murtessa, and she begins to take affection for Jay despite Nya claiming they were together. Murtessa then allows the ninja to stay and calls Nya a "Yang Servant".

Nya was furious at Jay for not stepping up and defending Nya. When the Munce call the ninja for their meal, they only request Jay to enter. Jay wasn't listening and was about to enter, but Nya pulls him aside and demands everyone to eat together.

While at the dining room, Jay continues to brag about his abilities such as turning all of the crystals to blue using his Elemental Powers. Murtessa was impressed and asks Jay if he had a special interest, but Nya interjects herself and claims she was with Jay. Murtessa then challenges Nya to a duel to determine Jay's partner, and Nya agrees.

Before the fight, Jay tells Nya that fighting isn't a good idea. Nya then tells Jay that if she doesn't fight, he would be stuck here forever, and eating disgusting food. Jay then begs Nya to win the fight.

Jay watches Nya take on Murtessa. At first, Nya was struggling but was able to pull out a victory when she uses Spinjitzu to knock Murtessa out. The Munce watch in shock and declare Nya as the new queen.

Grief-Bringer[]

Nya watches the Munce fight over whether they should attend the truce meeting with the Geckles. In order to get their attention, she uses her Elemental Powers to blast a Munce and demands everyone to head to the meeting. The Munce obey her orders and they head off.

When they get to the meeting point, Nya was surprised to see Kai as the chancellor of the Geckles. The siblings take a moment to hug each other, but the rivalry of the Geckles and Munces intensifies and they point weapons at each other. Nya and the ninja were able to break up the conflict, but they were forced to flee after hearing the sound of Grief-Bringer.

The Darkest Hour[]

The ninja, Geckles, and Munce were running away from Grief-Bringer and decide to hide in the Geckle Strong-Cave.

When Nya and the Munce were trying to close the gate, Kai and the rest of the ninja head out to buy time for them to close it. The ninja perform Spinjitzu to defeat most of the Awakened Warriors, but they quickly rebuild themselves. Murtessa was able to break the chains to the gate and the ninja retreat back in.

Tensions once rise between the two tribes as Gulch was upset that the Munce were in his shelter.

Even though both sides dislike each other, they both were fearful when Grief-Bringer and the Awakened Warriors attempt to tear down the gate. Nya recognizes a pile of rocks covering something and asks the Geckles and Munce to work together to remove the rocks. Kai marvels at their teamwork, and when they're done, he enters first. However, he discovers there's no other way out.

Murtessa and Gulch apologize to each other and Kai and Nya officially establish peace with the opposing tribes. At the same time, the Skull Sorcerer destroys the gate and was about to fight until the ninja decide to surrender themselves and allow the Geckles and Munce to be free. The Skull Sorcerer agrees and the ninja were taken away.

The Upply Strike Back![]

Nya and the ninja were locked up in a cage and overlook the Geckles and Munce working in the mines. Nya feels foolish for trusting the Skull Sorcerer that he would keep his promise.

The Skull Sorcerer approaches their cage and informs the ninja they'll be destroyed by Grief-Bringer. The Skull Sorcerer then reveals himself to be Vangelis and tells the ninja he disposed Cole and Wu into the heart of the mountain.

During the execution ceremony, Nya and the ninja watch in fear as Grief-Bringer was about to be released, but he doesn't come out. Cole then shows himself and fights the Skull Sorcerer. The ninja cheer him on and wish they could join the fight as well. While the Munces and Geckles were also fighting, Plundar and Adam free the ninja so they could join the fight.

The Son of Lilly[]

Nya continues to fight the Awakened Warriors alongside the ninja, Upply, Munce, and Geckles. Despite being overwhelmed, they receive aid when Vania and the Winged Guards of Shintaro arrive as well.

After Cole unlocks the Spinjitzu Burst, Nya watches Vangelis being taken away by his former guards.

During the ceremony, Vania was declared Queen of Shintaro and she promises peace for everyone. After the ceremony was finished, the ninja wave good-bye as they board the Bounty.

Prior to The Island

Prior to The Island[]

Sometime after the ninja settled back down following the battle for Shintaro Mountain, Nya invented a dance sequence in secret for Dancy Pants and named it "The Electric Jaya" after Jay and herself, and she was excited to show it to Jay. Nya spoke on this and a number of other topics in an interview conducted with her at the monastery before Cecil Putnam showed up.[9]

The Island

The Island[]

Uncharted[]

Nya and the rest of the ninja met with Cecil Putnam in the Monastery of Spinjitzu, with Cecil informing them that Misako and Master Wu had gone missing on a mission with Clutch Powers to find an uncharted island in the storm belt. The ninja, including Nya, then headed to the Destiny's Bounty to find Tim Batterson and head to the island.

Approaching the storm belt on the Bounty with P.I.X.A.L on board, Nya and the other ninja were informed that, because the storm belt was too strong for the Destiny's Bounty to fly any further, they would have to deploy onto catamarans to reach the island. The ninja and Twitchy Tim then deployed onto the boats to approach the island, with Nya on the same catamaran as Lloyd and Tim.

After sailing for some time, Nya noticed waves, indicating that they were approaching somewhere. The fog then revealed that there was a large mass of rock formations in front of them, threatening to destroy their catamaran. The other ninja also noticed the same thing.

Dodging the rock formations in a heavy storm, Lloyd noticed a rock formation too narrow to sail through. Nya responded by pressing one of the buttons on the catamaran, causing the boat to become narrower and longer, allowing the boat to pass through.

Reaching the island, P.I.X.A.L sent large containers with 3 Jungle Choppers to the ninja. Nya and the other ninja drove them a short distance along the coast of the island until they reached Miasko's abandoned base. Noticing a help sign made of stones, Nya later leapt into a Jungle Chopper with Twitchy Tim and sped off into the jungle with the other ninja in search of Wu and Misako.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

Nya drove through the jungle in her Jungle Chopper alongside the other ninja. Taking a brief pause, Lloyd told the others that he thought he saw an animal.

Coming to a stretch of narrow, dense jungle, Nya and the others dismounted their vehicles and started walking into the tropical forest. Hearing something again, Nya looked around when a dragon came and pounced on her, licking her. Noticing that the dragon was friendly and only wanted to play fetch, Jay named it Zippy. Nya, after being told by Lloyd that they needed to focus on the mission, reluctantly used her water powers to throw a coconut far away, leading the dragon away from them.

Venturing deeper into the jungle, Nya and the ninja stumbled upon a statue. Telling the others that there was nothing to fear from the inanimate statue, Nya tapped on the statue, awakening it.

The Stone Guardians and its brothers jumped off, defeating the ninja. Despite her best efforts, Nya was thrown back at Lloyd by one of the Stone Guardians before they stacked to form a totem pole, blasting lightning at the ninja.

Nya and the other ninja retreated from the Stone Guardians, running across a rope bridge. Afterwards, Nya noticed Lloyd wasn't with the group when she was electrocuted alongside the other ninja by a mysterious force.

When Nya woke up she found herself and the other ninja tied down to a catamaran, sailing towards what turned out to be a coastal town. Nya and the others were forced onto a lift and sent to Chief Mammatus, where he accused them of attempting to steal the Storm Amulet, showing the amulet to them, revealed his group as the Keepers of the Amulet, and ordered the ninja to be jailed.

The Gift of Jay[]

The Keepers marched Nya and the other ninja to the prison cell while Jay was taken somewhere else. Nya and the others found Master Wu, Misako, and Clutch Powers in the cell, with Nya mentioning that she's worried about what the Keepers were going to do to Jay.

Later, Lloyd successfully unlocked the cell, ordering the ninja, Misako, and Wu split up to search for Jay. Regrouping later, the group informed each other that Jay was nowhere to be found. Noticing that Clutch Powers was missing, Nya and the others found him attempting to steal the Storm Amulet when they were caught and electrocuted by the Keepers.

Nya woke up tied to a stake on the beach and noticed the others in the same situation. She then noticed that the Keepers were bringing Jay out on a throne, carrying him to the end of a pier. Nya watched as the Keepers put Jay on a boat and sent him out onto the ocean. She then witnessed a speech by Chief Mammatus, proclaiming that Jay was a gift to Wojira, with Misako informing the others that Wojira was a powerful storm spirit. The group saw Wojira rise through the fog, Jay sailing right to it.

The Tooth of Wojira[]

Kai burned through the group's ropes, allowing Nya and the others to escape. When Chief Mammatus noticed the group free, he ordered the other Keepers to attack. Nya and the others fought through the attacking soldiers, running towards the coast. Zane created an ice bridge across the water to reach Jay. When Nya and the ninja arrived at his location, Lloyd attempted to free Jay from his ropes. However, Wojira shot a fireball at Lloyd, forcing him off Jay's boat. Lloyd shot back, knocking something off the beast. Nya and the other ninja watched as Jay was pulled into the fog by Wojira.

When the ninja returned to the beach, Nya watched Lloyd explain to the Keepers that Wojira doesn't exist, showing a wooden tooth that he picked up. Lloyd told them that the Keepers had been tricked to send sacrifices. Chief Mammatus explained that when Wojira appeared, the Keepers kept sending gifts to appease the beast, until they had nothing left. The Keepers decided to make the ultimate sacrifice to protect the amulet, which was why they sent Jay. At Nya's request, the Keepers agreed to help rescue Jay.

Later, Nya and the other ninja launched a surprise attack at the "Wojira"s hideout, defeating an army of escaped Kryptarium prisoners. During the fight, Ronin revealed himself to be the architect of the operation and began to escape in "Wojira". Suddenly, Twitchy Tim arrived on one of the Keepers' catamarans, ramming it into Ronin's vessel and sinking it. Nya picked Twitchy Tim out from the water.

With Ronin caught, Chief Mammatus apologized to the ninja when he noticed that the Storm Amulet was missing. Nya then noticed that Clutch Powers wasn't with the group, and quickly caught up to him at the pier and electrocuted him, returning the amulet to the Keepers.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Nya entered the courtyard after Wu was shocked to see a giant hole in the middle of the wall. Nya questioned whether Jay and Kai messed up again and Wu said that he instructed the two to meditate on the six fundamental virtues of Spinjitzu. After Jay and Kai forgot the six virtues, Wu asked Nya if she remembered, but she too failed to provide an answer.

With the ninja forgetting the virtues, Wu ordered them to meditate immediately. While meditating, Nya opened her eyes and got scared by Wu who was standing close to her. While Wu went away to attend to the door, Nya commented on how the ninja had incorrect meditating positions and would have to deal with a grumpy Wu. She then heard a roar and asked if the rest of the ninja heard it as well, but they tune her out trying to focus on meditating. Hearing the roar again, Nya decided to stop meditating and investigate the sound. When she opened the door, she was shocked to see Wu grasped by a green dragon. The ninja tried to fight the dragon, but the dragon was able to deflect their attacks and escape through a portal. The ninja then entered the portal hoping to save their master.

Balance[]

The ninja exited through the portal and saw the green dragon. Kai saw Wu and was about to run to him, but Nya pulled him back and pointed out the lava separating them and Wu. Watching Jay and Lloyd attempting to cross the lava, the rest of the ninja were ambushed by Pyro Whippers. Nya attempted to use his Elemental Powers, but was unable to use it due to the extreme temperatures. Realizing her attacks were ineffective, Nya began crossing the lava, but had to deal with the Lava Monster. Fortunately, they were saved by the Thunder Dragon and enter the next portal.

Wisdom[]

Nya and the ninja raced in the Speedway Five-Billion attempting to reach the portal at the finish line. However, the Whack Rats were blocking their way and kept respawning every time they were defeated. Lloyd then realized they needed to be defeated in order to get across and after he "died", he respawned near the portal. The rest of the ninja followed suit and entered the next portal.

Honesty[]

Nya and the ninja were trapped in a cage and watched as Kai and Jay jousted in order to earn their freedom. After Jay told the truth of falling in his win, the Ice Emperor was pleased Jay told the truth and freed the rest of the ninja. The Ice Emperor then opened the next portal for the ninja to find Wu.

Generosity[]

Nya and the ninja fought the Awakened Warriors in the Mines of Shintaro. After saving the Geckles from the warriors, the ninja used the catapult to launch themselves to the next portal.

Courage[]

Nya and the ninja found themselves on the Island of the Keepers with Nya in her Tuner Car. They discovered Wu held captive by the Legendary Dragon along with three other dragons surrounded by a forcefield. As a strategy, Nya suggested they assess the situation and look for weaknesses, but Kai disregarded all of the strategies suggested by the ninja and took the dragons head on. Kai destroyed the forcefield allowing Jay and Nya to defeat one of the smaller dragons. Despite the ninja defeating the dragons and saving Wu, their master informed them it was merely a lesson to teach the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

Tasked with stopping Miss Demeanor from escaping, Nya created a massive tornado made out of water. However, she was unable to control it as it spiraled towards a local village. The ninja were forced to abandon the chase on Miss Demeanor and evacuate the village to high ground just before the tornado of water flooded the village.

While the rest of the ninja informed Master Wu of their failed mission, Nya takes full responsibility and promises that she'll never lose control of her powers. When the other ninja seemingly agree, Nya becomes annoyed, which causes the emergency sprinkler activates, short circuiting all the electronics.

Frustrated, Nya takes her anger by training in the courtyards. While training, Kai walks by and suggests that her sister call their mother, Maya, to help with her problems. However, Nya loathes the idea still believing that she had stability as she destroys the training post.

While walking along the hallway, Nya passes by the bathroom, being cleaned by Jay, and the toilet suddenly bursts on him. She then sees the tap in the kitchen which ends up bursting on Zane, and the soda bottles bursting on Cole as Nya passes by the game room. Intent on leaving, Nya was stopped by the others, who try to speak to her, only to be interrupted by someone knocking at the gates. Nya gets it, discovering it was her parents. Maya greets her while Ray was carrying all their luggage before they leave to unpack. Realizing that her brother had gone against her wishes, Nya angrily confronts Kai, who can only shrug as he says 'What?'.

The Call of the Deep[]

The next morning, Nya was awoken by her mother at six AM, much to her irritation. While Maya tidied up Nya's messy room and made passing comments about the state of her daughter's living quarters, Nya grumpily lay back on her bed and groaned about her mother's presence. Sometime later, Nya walked into the Monastery's kitchen and discovered, to her surprise, that her mother had made breakfast. When Maya set the table, Nya picked at her food and asked why the bacon served with her pancakes were green. To her disgust, Maya revealed that it wasn't bacon and that she made some Seaweed and tofu pancakes, believing that it could get her daughter more in tune with her element. When Nya opened her mouth to protest against eating the gross breakfast, Maya shoveled a spoonful of it into Nya's mouth.

After breakfast, mother and daughter stood together in the courtyard where the former began consistently criticizing Nya's water stance, much to her annoyance. After several minutes of critique, Nya finally snapped back at her mother, but caught herself and simply stated through gritted teeth that her water stance was fine and that she only lost control as a one time occurrence. No sooner after she said this, Nya inadvertently drew the water from bucket in the courtyard and splashed it back to the ground with such force that the bucket itself flew into the air and landed atop her head.

Eventually, Nya went to Wu in the monastery's library to complain about Maya's actions and asked if he had found anything that they could use to convince Maya to leave. In response, Wu revealed that there was surprisingly little information about the element of water and calmly admitted that Maya may have been there only hope at learning more about what was going on with Nya's powers. With some urging by Misako, Nya then decided to seek out her brother for help. Unfortunately, Kai was of no help, as he was busy catching up with their father and were playing video games together. When Nya's fears that her brother loved being waited on by their parents was confirmed, Nya sighed and headed down to the Samurai X Cave to see if there was anything else she could help with.

In the Samurai X Cave, Nya learned from Lloyd and Cole that Zane and P.I.X.A.L. had gone off on a water rescue without even mentioning the mission to Nya, much to her further dismay. With a sigh, she turned and left the cave, deciding to enjoy some quiet time to herself in the makeshift hot-tub made from the Bell of Divinity. Unfortunately, not even in solitude could the poor young woman find some peace that day, for as soon as she stepped into the tub and began to relax, a sudden pulse of energy caused all of the tub's water to erupt out from it.

Fearing that this eruption was her doing, Nya sheepishly returned to the monastery where she found everyone mopping up the flooded halls. Sadly, Nya apologized to her friends, believing that their troubles were all her doing. At that moment, however, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. returned to the monastery and proposed their new theory that Nya wasn't the one responsible for all of water going haywire. Nya would then listen on wordlessly as the two Nindroids explained their discovery of a strange energy pulse emanating from the Tartarus Trench.

Unsinkable[]

Nya and the others made their way to the docks of Ninjago City, where P.I.X.A.L. presented them with the Hydro Bounty. When Cole referenced the fate of ships branded "unsinkable," Nya reacted to Cole's comments with a horrified expression, helping to clue in to the Earth ninja the inappropriateness of his comment. As the ninja inspected this impressive new vessel, Nya voiced some questions regarding Zane and P.I.X.A.L.'s belief that the energy pulse was responsible for causing the fluctuations in her control over water, concerns that Zane insisted were likely to be unfounded. Although Nya suggested that she could sit the mission out in case of a worst possible scenario, Wu convinced her against such a suggestion by rhetorically asking if she preferred to stay at the monastery with her overbearing mother.

Later that evening, Nya explained the difficulties of this new mission to her parents, insisting to her mother in particular that she would be fine embarking on it. As night fell, Nya boarded the Hydro Bounty alongside Lloyd, Jay, Zane, and P.I.X.A.L., where she would man the ship's sonar. As their journey began, Nya questioned why Zane was suddenly talking like a pirate and would quickly find herself growing annoyed by his antics.

As their journey towards Tartarus Trench continued, Nya sat quietly beside a window in the ship's galley and gazed silently outside into the dark depths. When Jay joined her in conversation, Nya voiced her concerns about what they could expect to find within these depths, for they had never been mapped before. She also emphasized that the deeper they dove, the stronger she could feel her connection to her elemental power. After leaving the galley, Nya made her way to the ship's washing machines, only to discover to her confusion that her clothes had already been washed, dried, and folded! Such perplexing discoveries quickly turned to concern, however, and Nya rushed out in search of Zane to alert him of the possibility of a stowaway hidden aboard their ship.

After discovering the presence of a stowaway and after giving chase for a moment, only to mysteriously lose their quarry after rounding a corner, Nya realized who the identity of the stowaway was. Glancing up towards the ceiling, Nya discovered her mother grasping at the ceiling lights, much to her dismay. When Maya attempted to defend her actions, Nya angrily insisted that she was here merely because she believed that Nya could not handle anything on her own and ordered Zane to turn the Hydro Bounty around so that they could drop Maya back home. When Zane protested such course of action as being impossible due to the great distance they had traveled by this point, Nya let out an exasperated sigh and joined her allies back on the bridge.

As they neared Tartarus Trench, the Hydro Bounty came under attack by an unknown assailant, cutting power to the vessel as it began sinking towards the bottom of the trench. Thanks to her quick thinking, Nya pointed out a ledge that they could land their submersible on to prevent it from falling further into the crushing depths of the deep ocean. After landing, Nya urged her allies to remain quiet, warning that their assailants could possibly still hear them.

Five Thousand Fathoms Down[]

Stranded within Tartarus Trench, Nya began attempting to repair the Hydro Bounty's battery while her mother pestered her with various suggestions and ideas. After growing increasingly irritated by her mother's unhelpful comments, Nya finally snapped at her and flatly stated that her 'help' wasn't helpful, even going as far as to snidely remind her mother of how she and Kai were forced to raise themselves growing up. Nya did, however, slightly back off after seeing her mother's hurt reaction and after being reminded from her that she and Ray didn't have a choice in leaving their children, as they were forcibly taken by Krux. With a sigh, Nya acknowledged Maya's point but added that she wasn't a child anymore and after spending her entire life fending for herself, it was too late for motherly need. After leaving the engine room, Nya discovered the boys standing about in the hallway with sheepish expressions, immediately cluing her into the realization that they heard every word of her argument with Maya. With another sigh, Nya returned to the bridge and informed P.I.X.A.L. that she was unable to repair the damage sustained by the Hydro Bounty.

Once all had gathered together in the bridge, Nya listened carefully to P.I.X.A.L.'s proposition of retrieving the unidentified energy source to recharge the Hydro Bounty's dead battery. She and the others then followed P.I.X.A.L. to the ship's holding bay where they were shown a pair of APS suits, one of which Nya immediately claimed, believing that she was the ideal candidate for such a mission. With no opposition from the others, Maya commandeered the other suit and both mother and daughter - past and present Masters of Water - descended into the cold depths of the trench to investigate the source of the energy pulse.

As they journeyed to their destination, Maya spoke privately with Nya, acknowledging that while it was clear the latter was upset with her, Maya noted that Nya did not yet know what it was like to make a huge sacrifice, and Maya hoped she would never have to. In her words, Maya explained that sometimes, there were no good choices to be made, but that was just "the way the cookie crumbles." In response, Nya dismissed her mother's comments by noting that she didn't like crumbly cookies but preferred chewy ones. Not long after, the tracker that Nya was provided with by P.I.X.A.L. began to beep, informing them that the source of the disturbance was straight up ahead. Following this, Nya and Maya discovered what appeared to be some kind of temple hidden far below the waves.

After surfacing inside the temple, Nya and Maya exited their APS suits after approaching a large door. After broadcasting the door's engravings to their allies back on the Hydro Bounty, Nya pushed her way through and hid behind a pillar as she began surveying their surroundings: all around them seemed to be some kind of eel people, and sleeping in the center of the chamber, was a massive sea serpent. Nya continued to observe as another, octopus looking fellow, entered the chamber and ordered one of the eels to awaken the serpent.
