As the eels inserted and powered up a 'talisman' on the serpent's forehead, Nya's eyes widened as the talisman began to glow with a purple coloration, realizing that she had seen something like it before back on the Island of the Keepers. At that moment, P.I.X.A.L. informed Nya over her comms that Zane had identified the serpent's identity as that of Wojira, and both she and Maya were ordered to retreat immediately.

Heeding this information, Nya and Maya began dashing towards the exit, but with rather poor timing. As soon as she emerged from behind the pillar, the talisman placed atop of Wojira's forehead exploded and released a pulse of energy. Being exposed in the open, Nya was caught by this pulse and briefly shocked by its electrical current, alerting her and Maya's presence to all present in the temple. Nevertheless, Nya recovered and she and her mother fled to their APS suits, but were attacked by the octopus man and his guards. After Maya's suit was damaged, Nya used her powers to blast away most of their attackers before turning her attention to her unconscious mother. Unfortunately, Nya had overlooked the fact that the octopus man had suctioned himself to the nearby chamber doors and was still active; this mistake would result in Nya being rendered unconscious as well from another blast from the octopus' trident.

The Wrath of Kalmaar[]

Upon awakening, Nya found herself chained to a pillar alongside her mother. After rousing her mother awake, Nya exclaimed that the two were still in the Temple of Wojira, much to Maya's confusion as the latter dismissed Wojira as being nothing more than a fairy tale. In reply, Nya began to reveal the details of her last adventure to the Island of the Keepers to her mother, but paused after catching a glimpse of Kalmaar. After Prince Kalmaar introduced himself and demanded for Nya to continue talking about the Keepers and the Storm Amulet, Nya chose instead to play dumb and insisted that Kalmaar would never get the details from her. Angered by this response, Kalmaar prepared to fire a burst of energy from his trident, but was startled by the sudden arrival of Gripe and instead blew apart a hole in the pillar that Nya and Maya were chained to, with one small piece of debris landing atop of Nya's head.

After Kalmaar and Gripe's departure, Nya and Maya began to make efforts to escape their shackles. When Maya noted that she had been in a similar situation before with Ray, Nya agreed to try out her mother's idea and the two began to simultaneously shimmy their way up the pillar towards the hole that Kalmaar had inadvertently blown. After several moments of struggle, both mother and daughter managed to escape from the pillar but were soon discovered by Gripe and several Maaray guards. Fortunately, the guards' awful aim managed to free one arm from each Master of Water from their shackles, though they both began running in opposite directions and were pulled back together thanks to the chain attached to their other arms. After recovering from this annoyance, Nya dragged her mother along towards the entrance of the temple, leading the way as the pair fought off several other Maaray guards in spite of their limitations.

After defeating several more of their enemies, Nya picked up one of the defeated guards' tridents and used it to free her mother from her shackles. The two then fought their way out to the entrance of the temple where their APS suits waited. Suiting up, mother and daughter fled from the Temple of Wojira and began making their way towards the Hydro Bounty.

Long Live the King[]

As Nya and her mother made their escape through the hydrothermal vents surrounding the Temple of Wojira, they discovered that three Ripper Sharks had been deployed after them and were now closing in on the pair. Despite their best efforts to outswim the sharks, Nya lamented that such actions were impossible as the creatures were in their element. In response to this, Maya reminded her daughter that this was her element too, leading for Nya to use her powers in an effort to push back against the sharks. Although Nya quickly dispatched two of them, she forgot about the third until it rammed into her APS suit. After shaking off the fish, Nya prepared to channel her powers through her suit, but unfortunately, the damage it had sustained from Kalmaar's previous attack plus the shark's ramming, caused such attempts to fail. Fortunately, the timely arrival of Lloyd and Jay with their Harpoon guns was enough to drive away the creature, allowing for Nya and Maya to safely board the Hydro Bounty.

After returning onboard their ship, Maya began to profusely thank Lloyd and Jay, exclaiming that she feared they would be done for had it not been for their intervention! Upon hearing this, Nya reacted with irritation, pointing out to her mother that she said Nya was handling things just fine! Before things could continue further however, another platoon of Maaray guards surrounded the Hydro Bounty and informed its passengers that King Trimaar had demanded for an audience with them. With no options, the group was then escorted to the Merlopian Palace and into Trimaar's throne room.

After meeting with the King, Nya argued that they wouldn't be trespassing in his kingdom had it not been for Kalmaar's actions in shooting down their vessel. This claim shocked Trimaar who then asked his visitors once more if it was true. When Maya affirmed Nya's claims, Nya added as well that she and Maya were held prisoner by Kalmaar and that he also intended to awaken Wojira. Having heard enough, Trimaar changed his tune and immediately called for his son to respond to these claims that were now brought before him. When Kalmaar entered the chamber, Nya and her allies watched as the prince responded with indignation to his father's questioning and gasped when Kalmaar fatally shot his father with his trident. Kalmaar then pinned the assault on the king on the ninja, forcing Nya and the others to flee once more.

As they ran through the halls of the Merlopian Palace, Nya and Zane used their powers in tandem to erect a massive wall of ice, separating them from the pursuing Maaray guards. Unfortunately, due to their unfamiliarity with the palace halls, the ninja wound up getting lost and their progress would be briefly halted by the palace's flooding under Kalmaar's orders. Stuck behind another door, the ninja were soon confronted by a second pair of ripper sharks in the flooded halls. Upon seeing them, Nya ordered Zane to erect another barrier of ice before turning to help Lloyd in opening the next door.

Escape from Merlopia[]

After several moments of unsuccessful attempts at opening the next door, the ripper sharks finally broke through the barrier of ice. Springing into action, Nya used her powers to generate a powerful water current, briefly pushing one away while holding the other at bay. Unfortunately, the sharks were adept swimmers and began to slowly make gains against Nya's current. Just as they neared her, the door suddenly sprang open, sucking the ninja inside before slamming shut once more in front of the sharks' snouts.

After recovering from the shock of their entry, Nya removed her mask to see a stranger standing before her. Introducing himself as Benthomaar, the adopted son of King Trimaar, Nya asked their new associate about Trimaar's condition and expressed her condolences when Benthomaar confirmed his passing. Following Benthomaar's lead, the ninja began following him through the halls of the palace, though Nya privately admitted to Jay that while she didn't trust him completely, he also didn't have to help them. After arriving in the palace's hanger bay, Nya watched on with a horrified expression as Jay claimed to the guards that the ninja were visitors from "Bubbletubblepopolis" and not the surface world. Anticipating Jay's claims to fall flat, Nya was one of the first to rip into a Spinjitzu tornado and began fighting against the surrounding Maaray guards. Once the Hydro Bounty was ready to depart, Nya called out for Lloyd to escape alongside with them.

Once the Hydro Bounty escaped from the limits of Merlopia, Nya checked on Lloyd's status and introduced the rest of the ninja to Benthomaar. Determined now to secure the Storm Amulet before Kalmaar could, Nya ordered P.I.X.A.L. to set course for the Island of the Keepers.

The Tale of Benthomaar[]

After Benthomaar finished telling his allies about his history with Kalmaar, Nya comforted the exiled prince, promising him that he was not alone.

The Storm Amulet[]

As they neared the Island of the Keepers, Nya and her allies pooled together the information they had on Wojira, with Nya noting that the amulets were slotted atop the Sea Serpent's forehead. As they sailed through the treacherous Lightning Lagoon, Nya steered the Hydro Bounty and at one point gently pointed out to Jay that his chair had a seatbelt after the latter was thrown about thanks to the rough waters. Upon reaching the shores of the island, Nya warned Benthomaar that the Keepers could be hostile to outsiders and suggested that he leave interactions with them to the ninja, as they had prior meetings with the Keepers.

After meeting once more with Mammatus, the ninja warned him of Kalmaar's machinations, though the Chief of the Islanders heeded the ninja's warnings by declaring that the Keepers shall immediately prepare for battle with the would-be invaders. Nya interjected to this plan, warning that Kalmaar's forces far outnumbered and outgunned the Keepers and that the best course of action would be to instead secure the Storm Amulet and to take it as far away from the island as possible. After some thought, Mammatus agreed to Nya's proposition and passed along the Storm Amulet to her for her safekeeping. Unfortunately, Zane quickly detected that the amulet in possession by the Keepers was a fake and Nya immediately realized that Clutch Powers had managed to steal the real amulet. Nya and the others then retreated to the Hydro Bounty to contact the other half of their team, reaching Cole, who Nya then updated about recent events. Nya then ordered Cole to retrieve the Storm Amulet from the Explorer's Club just as Kalmaar and his forces stormed the Hydro Bounty.

Feigning defeat, Nya told Jay to hand the "Storm Amulet" to Kalmaar, but unfortunately, Kalmaar had already heard that the one in possession of the ninja was a counterfeit and that the real one was located at the Explorer's Club. Although the ninja prepared to defend themselves against Kalmaar and his forces, the wrathful King of Merlopia struck first, heavily damaging the Hydro Bounty before departing, declaring that he would leave his foes stranded on the shores of the island so that they could watch and know of Kalmaar's victory once the seas rose and swallowed the land. Kalmaar then singled out Nya specifically, mockingly pointing out to her that if it hadn't been for her, he would never have learned of the existence of the Storm Amulet, let alone its resting place. As he and his forces departed, a furious Nya briefly swam out in pursuit but was forced to break off for air.

After some time, Nya frantically asked P.I.X.A.L. if the damage done to the Hydro Bounty could be repaired and began to break down when the latter affirmed that the damage was too extensive. Maya then stepped in to comfort her daughter, stating that she was a better Master of Water than Maya ever had been and that she had complete faith that her daughter would find a way for them all to escape the island and defeat Kalmaar.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Benthomaar inquired if Nya had the ability to summon whales to tow the damaged Hydro Bounty. Finding such inquiry to be incredulous, Nya immediately dismissed it as an impossibility, emphasizing that she only had the powers to control water. When Benthomaar asked if she had tried before, Nya admitted she never had either and agreed to at least try it.

Wading out into the shallows of Lightning Lagoon, Nya closed her eyes and placed her hands into the water. To her surprise, some of the local fish seemed to have reacted to this action and now gathered around Nya's feet. Turning to her friends, Nya asked if they had any idea as to what she should be doing now, but none had any more insightful suggestions either.

After some time of no further progress, Nya grew increasingly frustrated and faceplanted herself into the water to muffle her angry screaming. Although Jay tried to offer some words of support, Nya rebuffed him and continued blaming herself for the situation they were all in now. Surprisingly, the underwater screaming managed to successfully summon a pod of whales which Nya were soon able to command into towing the Hydro Bounty to Ninjago City.

Master of the Sea[]

Now towed by whales towards Ninjago City, Nya listened on as Benthomaar told his allies the story of Nyad and the Battle of Nine Days. At the conclusion of Benthomaar's story, Nya emphasized again how important it was for them to prevent Kalmaar from obtaining the Storm Amulet, but conceded that the whales were pulling them as fast as they possibly could.

Upon arriving at the docks of Ninjago City just in time, Nya called out Kalmaar and fought against his platoon of Maaray guards before turning her attention to the wicked king himself. When Kalmaar roared with anger about her escape, Nya smiled and snidely stated in response that she was beginning to enjoy ruining Kalmaar's plans. Unfortunately, Nya would be overpowered by Kalmaar in their brief struggle but was saved from a fatal blow thanks to Benthomaar's intervention. As Kalmaar retreated with the Storm Amulet in his possession, Nya commanded a whale to give chase and pursued him beneath the waves. Through her pursuit Nya avoided a pair of torpedoes fired by Kalmaar's chariot and summoned a second whale to distract the king so that she could swoop in and snatch the Storm Amulet from his hands. With the amulet secured, Nya rushed back towards the surface in victory, unaware that Kalmaar had secretly switched out the real amulet for the fake one Nya had presented to him at the Island of the Keepers.

Upon resurfacing, Nya swam back to the Hydro Bounty and informed her allies that while Kalmaar escaped, she had managed to retrieve the Storm Amulet from his clutches. Believing that they were victorious, the ninja returned to the Monastery where Nya gave a tour to Benthomaar while Cole brought the fake amulet to Shintaro for safekeeping. At the conclusion of the tour, Nya offered Benthomaar a place at the Monastery, knowing that his brother still ruled over Merlopia for the time being. When Benthomaar accepted Nya's gracious offer, she returned inside to send off her parents, discovering to her disgust that Kai and Ray were exchanging goodbyes while still playing video games. With her mother however, Nya apologized for her previous behavior and expressed hope that the two could have more adventures together in the future.

The Calm Before the Storm[]

Two days after the Ninja's seeming victory over Kalmaar, Nya met up with Jay for a date at Benny's Arcade Emporium. Once her boyfriend entered, Nya called him over to the Dancy Pants game where she told him that she had been practicing a new dance move that she dubbed "The Electric Jaya." When Jay expressed his approval, Nya revealed that the move required both of them to execute it successfully, describing it as "Being like dancing together while also dodging shurikens." The two then danced together on the game platform until the machine overloaded and exploded trying to record their high score. The couple's moment of victory however, would be interrupted by Wu over their comms, asking for them to report immediately to the Ninjago City Police Station.

Shortly afterwards, the two met up with Wu, Zane, and Benthomaar at the police station and were led to an interrogation room where Glutinous sat. To Nya's horror, Glutinous revealed that Kalmaar had managed to trick Nya into taking the facsimile Storm Amulet and had since awoken Wojira. Now armed with this knowledge, Nya and the other ninja issued an emergency evacuation alert for Ninjago City and rushed out to prepare for the approaching storm.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

As the Great Flood began, Nya patrolled the now flooded streets of Ninjago City alongside Jay, aiming to rescue any civilians still trapped in the rushing waters. From her vantage point atop a highway overpass, Nya spotted a man struggling against the current and dove in to rescue him, delivering him to safety with her grappling gun. Once the man was secure, Nya realized his identity as her longtime ally, Dareth. To her surprise though, Dareth responded to her greeting by pointing and excitedly shouting to the other rescued civilians that the ninja did know him!

After bringing Dareth and the civilians to safety, Nya and Jay moved to intercept Kalmaar and Wojira's advances on the Destiny's Bounty, though the pair would only arrive after the flying ship was downed by Wojira. Nya then attacked Wojira with bursts of water, releasing Jay's Sub car from her jaws. When Kalmaar noticed Wojira, Nya declared to him in defiance that his assault would end now before using the water she was manipulating to propel herself upwards to Kalmaar and Wojira to attack!

Nyad[]

Moving in on Kalmaar, Nya opened her attack by hurling several volleys of water at him, though these were dispersed by the king with his trident. Nya then attempted to launch herself in a kick towards Kalmaar, but was knocked away and off of Wojira. In spite of this stumble, she was able to recover and raised a platform of water beneath her feet to continue her attack. Unfortunately, Kalmaar was able to once again gain an upper hand against Nya, forcing her to retreat while vowing to return to finish what she had started.

By sunset, Nya regrouped with her allies atop the Ninjago News Center. When Benthomaar met them carrying an unconscious Jay, Nya rushed over to her boyfriend's side and frantically asked what had happened to him, learning that Jay's lungs had been filled with seawater during his rescue. After giving a brief glare at Kalmaar when the latter passed by atop Wojira and gloated over his victory, Nya helped Jay down the stairs and laid him atop a sofa before unsuccessfully attempting to draw the excess water from his lungs. When this failed, Nya held his hand tightly and sat beside him as Jay's condition worsened. After listening to her allies discuss possible ways to save Jay's life, but with none of those ideas being workable ones, Nya walked over to Benthomaar and quietly asked him how Nyad merged with the Endless Sea. Although Benthomaar answered her question as asked, he cautioned her not to even think of considering such an attempt, emphasizing that Nyad lost her identity to the sea after merging with it and that such a process could not be undone. Silently, Nya turned her gaze out towards one of the windows, deep in thought but briefly reacting with concern after Jay coughed violently once more.

Throughout the night, Nya down at Jay's side before eventually falling asleep, stirring at the crack of dawn as the sun's rays shown down on her. Awoken, Nya turned to look once more at the faces of her sleeping allies before turning back to Jay. With a sad smile, Nya whispered to him her wish that they had more time together and kissed him on the cheek before stepping up towards the roof of the news center; she had made up her mind about what she was going to do. As she stood by the roof's edge and looked down into the waters below, she hesitated and turned once more towards the stairwell she had just emerged from. With tears in her eyes, Nya smiled and whispered, "I love you." As a single tear rolled across her face, knowing very well what fate awaited her, Nya turned and dove into the Endless Sea, opening her heart to it as she merged with it. During the process of merging, Nya was able to draw out the excess water from Jay's lungs, saving his life before her flesh and bone became one with the waters surrounding her. Once the process was complete, Nya swam up to the side of the News Center's windows and placed her hand on the glass to meet Jay's hand, then propelled herself off to find and defeat Kalmaar and Wojira, once and for all. Emerging out of the waters surrounding the Police Station, Nya revealed herself to Kalmaar and declared that he was going to wish he had never crossed her. With a furious shout, Nya launched herself to attack her hated foe.

The Turn of the Tide[]

Flying through the air, Nya hurled ball after ball of water at Kalmaar until she landed atop Wojira's forehead. Glaring at her opponent, Nya began to slowly advance towards him, undeterred by his energy blasts thanks to her new liquid form. Upon reaching Kalmaar, she roundhouse kicked him and prepared to blast him with more torrents of water, but halted her attack when Jay called out her name. This distraction afforded Kalmaar the ability to counterattack, and he struck Nya with a concentrated burst of energy from his trident, momentarily vaporizing her humanoid form.

Following Kalmaar's defeat by Bethomaar's hands and his subsequent devourment by Wojira, Nya resurfaced in the form of a liquid water dragon. As Wojira prepared to obliterate her foes and allies alike, Nya struck at the Storm Serpent with a blast of water, challenging her to battle. Nya then initiated her attack, flying down and plucking Wojira from the waves and hurling her against the side of a building. In retaliation, Wojira responded by ramming Nya against a different building before going after her allies once again. As Wojira attacked the ninja, Nya swooped in and hoisted Wojira away by the latter's horns, slamming her against a skyscraper. Wojira responded to this attack by diving into the depths of the sea before resurfacing behind Nya and calling upon the Storm Amulet to strike Nya repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Once Nya was stunned, Wojira struck and vaporized her again with the Fury of the Storm.

As Wojira prepared now to finally obliterate the watching ninja, a sudden raincloud formed overhead, catching the Storm Serpent's attention. Accompanied by the crackle of thunder, Nya reformed her dragon form with the rain and moisture in the air. Swooping down towards Wojira and building momentum, Nya reverted to her humanoid shape with her fist outstretched and eyes shut, bracing herself for impact. And with one mighty blow, Nya struck and destroyed the Wave Amulet. Without the this amulet's powers to counteract the Storm Amulet, Wojira lost control over her remaining powers and rose into the air as lightning swirled around, vanishing entirely.

With victory secured, Nya launched herself up towards the roof of the police station, where the other ninja cheered her on. However, something seemed off, and Nya could not remember why she had made her way to the rooftop in the first place. As her friends and loved ones gathered around her, Nya expressed confusion over their comments regarding "normalcy" and instead asked if they too heard the call of the sea. As her humanoid form fluctuated, Nya told her friends that she would be leaving them, but she would always remember them. As she began to walk away, Jay attempted to plead with her, begging for her to stay, but his words fell upon deaf ears; although Nya knew he meant something to her once, things had changed and she was no longer the girl he once knew. In spite of this, Jay's pleas managed to briefly reach Nya's fading humanity and sense of self, halting her advance towards the sea. With a sad smile, Nya briefly took Jay's hands into her own, running her hand against the side of his face for one last time before returning to the sea. In their parting exchanges, Nya affirmed to Wu that her identity was not lost (or at least not yet), and for Jay to tell Maya that she now knew what Maya meant by "the way the cookie crumbles." Finally, Nya dove into the Endless Sea and commanded the floodwaters to recede from Ninjago City, ending the Great Flood. With one final look, Nya affirmed her friendship with the ninja before swimming out into the Endless Sea and disappearing from view.

One sundown, days later, Nya swam through the waves with a pod of whales, laughing and giggling as she sped through her new, watery home.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

For a year after her sacrifice, Nya roamed the Endless Sea and occasionally saved the lives of those who found themselves at the sea's mercy. Her sightings led to the development of rumors and tall-tales among Ninjago's fishermen, and at least one reported sighting near Merlopia prompted Benthomaar to leave his throne to investigate. His absence though would inspire Gripe to make an attempt at seizing the throne, but he would be consistently repelled by clashes with the ninja.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

The Call of Home[]

A ship was out in a storm causing Kwon to fall overboard. Luckily, Nya in her water dragon form saved the man and the crew thanked Nya for her help. Confused about the name, the dragon repeated the name before diving back into the sea.

While swimming, the dragon tried to recall where she heard the name "Nya". She was soon approached by another water spirit who questions her actions. The dragon tells her she interfered because it's who she was, yet she cannot remember who she was. They travel to the bottom to see if a boat was what she was looking for but it does not help her. So the water spirit suggested her to look above on the surface instead to which the dragon thanked her and said she will.

On her way to the surface, she saw lights floating along the water. The lights turned out to be lanterns with messages and she read some of them about thanking Nya and missing her presence. The last one she read tells her Jay must be very sad without her and asked her to come home. At Jay's name, she regained her memories, reminiscing those of her closest friends, family, and herself. She transformed into her humanoid water form and declared herself as Nya. Above the waters, she saw where the line of lanterns ended and swam for Lighthouse Island.

However, when she arrived, she found the lighthouse empty, except for some more lanterns and paintings of herself and Jay. She wondered how long she'd been gone when she saw Jay's portrait of himself with a beard and she suddenly lost form. She struggled to maintain it and realized she had to get back to the ocean. There, Nya found the water spirit and told her she remembered everything about herself and her, who was Nyad, the one who fought off Wojira. Although Nyad didn't remember that and simply told Nya that was nice. Nya then begged for her help to break free from the ocean to go home but Nyad told her that it was impossible since she merged with the sea connecting her completely with the sea forever.

Discouraged, Nya sank to the bottom and Nyad came after her, asking why she was sad when she had everything in the ocean forever. Nya replied that she could never be happy in the ocean when all her friends were back home and her fear of forgetting everything again. Nyad apologized and told her with the sea connected to her elemental powers, there was no way she could give those up. At that, Nya realized that if she could give up her powers, she could sever herself from the ocean. Nyad told her it could be possible but tells her she was her powers and asks what she would be without them. Nya confessed that was her greatest fear, becoming ordinary, but knew that losing her friends would be worse. She hugged Nyad and thanked her for everything, telling her she had to go. When Nyad asked where, Nya said "Home" and took off to find her friends.

The Shape of Nya[]

When Kai and Jay nearly came to blows in the Monastery's Samurai X Cave, Kai's flames activated the cave's sprinkler system. Nya traveled through the water dispensed by the sprinklers and reformed herself before her friends, startling them. Addressing Jay, Nya revealed that there was a way back for her to be restored to human flesh, specifically requiring her elemental powers to be drained before she lost her shape. Analyzing the situation, Zane promptly froze Nya with his powers, determining that solidifying her would buy the Ninja enough time to find Aspheera and drain Nya's powers.

A Mayor Problem[]

In order to preserve Nya's frozen state, Zane continued blasting her with his cryogenic powers. As he was needed, however, for a mission to release Aspheera, Skylor was called in to take over for him. Skylor then fulfilled Zane's task of keeping Nya frozen for several hours while the ninja sought to break Aspheera out of prison.

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

Still encased in ice, P.I.X.A.L. expressed concern about Nya's state, warning that if her core temperature rose higher than zero degrees, her stability would be at risk. Although Skylor grunted that she was doing the best she could with her fading powers of ice, Zane returned just in time to blast Nya with his cryogenic powers and lower her core temperature.

Moments later, Aspheera observed Nya's frozen state and questioned what kind of power was responsible for transforming her into water, with the ninja explaining it as the result of her merger with the Endless Sea.

A Painful Promise[]

Once again, Skylor found herself in a situation where the power of Ice she had copied from Zane was quickly running out while Nya's frozen state continued to melt. Fortunately, Zane and the other ninja returned just in time with Aspheera's staff to refreeze Nya and also for the sorceress to restore her to normal.

After initially betraying the ninja, Aspheera finally agreed to drain Nya of her powers in exchange for being shown the secret exit out of the Samurai X Cave to avoid being recaptured by the police. Although Aspheera warned she had never drained the powers of someone as powerful as Nya's watery state and she had no idea of what the potential consequences could be, Aspheera ultimately succeeded and restored Nya to her flesh and bone, albeit unconscious.

After the other ninja were hauled away by the New Ninja to answer for the crimes they had committed in the process of saving Nya's life, Wu carried Nya's unconscious body to the Monastery's longue, gently setting her down atop the couch. As Wu laid her down, Nya finally stirred and asked Wu if she had been restored to her human form and where the other ninja were.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

Nya attended the ninja's trial hearing and subsequent sentencing in court. Although the Honorable Judge William Toughbutt stated that he was going to be lenient on the ninja, providing Nya with a sense of hope, he still sentenced them to five years in Kryptarium Prison, much to her shock and dismay. As the ninja were escorted past the observer pews and out of the courthouse, Nya called out to Jay who called back out to her in reply.

Later at the Monastery, Nya overheard Wu's statements that he was glad the ninja were facing punishment for breaking the law, much to her irritation. When Wu explained the reasoning behind his comments, Nya blamed herself for their predicament and angrily stormed off.

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

Denied visitation rights to see the ninja by Judge Toughbutt, Nya began rummaging around her room in the Monastery, filling up boxes with her weapons and training equipment. When Wu interjected and inquired about her actions, Nya stated that she was doing some "spring cleaning" by getting rid of things she didn't need anymore, now that she was no longer an Elemental Master. Although Wu tried his best to talk her out of her actions, Nya pushed back against his advice until Wu brought up a child's drawing that had been gifted to Nya many years ago when she then wore the mantle of Samurai X. Taking the time to read the letter written on the reverse side of the drawing, Nya felt a sudden burst of inspiration as she unrolled the blueprints for her old mech.

After making some design changes to the blueprints, Nya hurried down to the Hanger Bay where she asked P.I.X.A.L. to help her in constructing a new Samurai X Mech based on the new designs she had drawn up. Her excitement, however, would be shortly tempered by P.I.X.A.L.'s estimation that the project would require 1,276 hours to complete, though she perked up ever so slightly when the latter added that she would have it ready in the morning, leaving Nya puzzled by P.I.X.A.L.'s assertation.

Hounddog McBrag[]

With her new mech completed, Nya participated in a plan orchestrated by Dareth to break the ninja out of prison. After discovering a prison bus enroute to Route 22, Dareth disguised himself as an elderly man and pretended his van had broken down while Nya ripped open the back of the prison bus to release the ninja. Once they had escaped, Nya gave Dareth a thumbs-up signal and overturned the bus to prevent the other inmates from escaping the bus before flying off.

The Spider's Design[]

Nya rushed into the hangar bay just as contact was lost with the four ninja who were investigating the Ninjago Metro and the abandoned N line.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

Within the hangar bay, Nya, Wu, Skylor, and P.I.X.A.L. continued to monitor the ninja's position and desperately attempted to reach them after losing contact some time ago. When Wu and Skylor disagreed about the ninja's fate, Nya reluctantly sided with Wu, remarking that the hangar's seismic sensors had picked up a powerful blast around the time they lost contact with their allies. At that moment, the group were alerted to an activation of the secret entrance elevator and rushed down to greet their new arrivals.

Nya and her allies then watched to their shock as four of their old enemies: Pythor, Aspheera, the Mechanic, and Vangelis, stepped out from the elevator and proclaimed their intention of stealing the Golden Weapons. Determined to prevent this at all costs, Nya and the others rushed into battle against the Council of the Crystal King, with Nya at first focusing on Vangelis, whom she knocked around in midair with a series of jump-kicks. Unfortunately, Pythor used his invisibility to backup his ally, escaping from Skylor to attack Nya as she rushed again at the fallen king. Vangelis would then take this opportunity to lift Nya through the air, hurling her across the hangar before turning his attention towards Wu.

When Nya recovered from her fall, she found herself face to face now with Pythor. In spite of her efforts against one of the ninja's oldest foes, Nya found herself surprised and out-matched by Pythor's combat skills, which had since greatly developed throughout the years since their last encounter. Injured by his vicious and powerful attacks, Nya crawled away from her old foe in desperation while he laughed at her apparent helplessness. Approaching her with a naginata in hand, Pythor mocked Nya over the loss of her powers and derisively stated that she should have stayed in the Endless Sea, adding with particular venom that that was where she belonged. Before the blow could be struck, however, Skylor intervened and grabbed Pythor by the tail, slamming him behind her to the side. Unfortunately, Pythor was quick to recover and counter-attacked, knocking both Skylor and Nya to the ground when the latter tried to exploit his moment of vulnerability.

While Wu fought against Vangelis, Aspheera, and the Mechanic alone, Pythor used his invisibility to sneak up on Nya from behind and ensnared her with his tail and powerful grip, holding the edge of his naginata to her throat. As Nya struggled to free herself, she managed to take advantage over Pythor's momentary distraction from the sight of the MiniPix to finally free herself and kick him in the chest for her troubles. Nya then regrouped with Wu and P.I.X.A.L. as the latter explained the purpose of the MiniPix, revealing them to have been her unseen helpers in expediting the ninja's various mechanical upgrades. Impressed by this, Nya admitted that up until now, she thought that P.I.X.A.L. had been somehow completing hundreds of hours of work in such short time by herself. Although the MiniPix were able to briefly turn the tide against the Council of the Crystal King, the arrival of scores of Crystal Spiders cemented the battle in favor of the Council. Overwhelmed and backed into a corner, Nya was confronted by Aspheera who revealed that Harumi was responsible for leading the Council, much to Nya's shock. Unfortunately, she would not have much further time to dwell on this realization, for Aspheera knocked her back into the main computer with Spinjitzu then brought the massive screen down upon her with a blast of magic.

Eventually, Nya managed to free herself from the rubble of the computer, only to discover that her allies were gone and she was trapped with the army of Crystal Spiders, all of whom were primmed to detonate with only seconds to go! After a frantic attempt at activating the elevator failed, Nya rushed to her Samurai X Mech and barely managed to hop into the cockpit just as the spiders exploded, heavily damaging the mech in the process. Fortunately, the mech managed to remain operational and Nya was able to escape from the ruined hangar bay and burning Monastery with its rockets. Nya was then dispatched by Wu to rescue the trapped ninja, who were buried beneath a mountain of rubble in the abandoned N line.

Darkness Within[]

Arriving at the coordinates of the abandoned N line in Ninjago City, Nya discovered that a portion of the street had been heavily damaged - likely from the detected blast. With her mech, Nya got to work excavating the spot and managed to narrowly save the ninja from being crushed by a massive piece of asphalt. She then briefed the boys about recent developments, including the destruction of the Monastery and Harumi's surprising return, before ferrying them all to the old Samurai X Cave that was being set up as their new headquarters for the time being.

As they neared the Samurai X Cave, Nya's damaged mech finally gave out and crashed just outside the cave's entrance. After squeezing herself out of the cockpit, Nya patted the mech and thanked it for its service before descending into the cavern with the others. After entering, Nya and Kai were hugged by Skylor, who was grateful for their survival and she then listened on as the reunited team made preparations to rescue Lloyd.

The Coming of the King[]

Alongside Jay, Nya worked on constructing one of the parts of a new vehicle. When the Samurai X Cave's main computer began beeping, Nya stepped in to assist Zane and quickly accessed the source of the sound, pulling up a map with Lloyd's location. She then explained to the others that the signal to Lloyd's tracking device had been restored and he was located in Primeval's Eye. When Wu warned that they would have to break the law again in order to steal back the impounded Destiny's Bounty to save Lloyd, Nya agreed and asked Wu what would be their plan of attack.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Atop a nearby rooftop, Nya and the other four ninja carefully planned their move on the Ninjago City Impound Lot. After observing the two security guards, Nya reiterated to the boys not to start their vehicles' engines until she gave the signal, adding that she would retake the Destiny's Bounty. When Jay proposed counting them off to three, Nya produced a grappling gun and immediately made her move towards the Bounty. Since the ninja were detected not long after, the boys decided to start their vehicles and speed off towards Primeval's Eye while Nya was still in the process of preparing the Bounty. As she winched in the ship's anchor, she discovered to her surprise that Wu was riding atop of it. Her master then explained that he would accompany the ninja and ordered for her to set course to Primeval's Eye.

Following Lloyd's tracker, Nya and Wu intercepted Lloyd before a cliff face and urged him to hop on board. Nya helped Lloyd board the ship and tackled him to the ground when the Council of the Crystal King attacked, riding on the backs of Dragonides. After Zane drove off Aspheera and Vangelis, Nya manned the ship's cannon and took aim at Mister F and the Mechanic, rapidly firing volleys of explosive projectiles at the two until they retreated. Nya then stood on the deck and watched alongside Wu as Zane flew by to signal to them that the skies had been cleared of their enemies. As she turned around, however, Nya gasped as she caught sight of the Crystal Island floating across the horizon.

Crystastrophe[]

Onboard Destiny's Bounty, Nya, Lloyd, and Wu monitored the original four ninja's battle in the Farmers' village against the horde of Crystal Warriors. As they observed, Nya warned that the four were losing ground to the seemingly indestructible Crystal Army before the topic shifted to the reemergence of the Overlord. Nya expressed her disbelief over his return, recalling that he had been destroyed by Zane in Ninjago City many years prior. At this moment, Wu broke his silence and admitted that the Overlord could not truly be destroyed, shocking Nya who asked Wu how long he had known this for.

When Wu brought up the mysterious newspaper clippings he had been receiving in the mail for quite some time, Nya participated in uncovering the identity of the peculiar pieces of parchment. After some discussion, Nya realized that they were likely from a newspaper delivery service and set course for Ninjago City, knowing exactly where to go and who to ask. After arriving at the Newspaper warehouse, Nya set down the Bounty's anchor and stayed onboard while Lloyd and Wu headed down to ask the Paperboys about the clippings.

A Lesson in Anger[]

Commandeering Destiny's Bounty, Nya set course to the farmer's village to help the original four ninja cover their retreat. Nya then ordered Jay to tow Cole's damaged Dragon Cruiser back to the Samurai X Cave and that she would go on ahead and meet up with them there, adding cryptically that they may have discovered a way to defeat the Crystal Army.

Later at the Samurai X Cave, Nya listened onward as Wu and Garmadon explained the existence of the Oni form and its ability to defeat the near-indestructible Vengestone Warriors. She then went on to watch Garmadon's attempts to train Lloyd, but began to grow distrustful of his teachings as Garmadon wound up doing a lot more yelling and criticizing than teaching. As she watched, Nya whispered into her brother's ear to criticize Garmadon's "teaching" skills. As her mistrust of Garmadon's methods grew, Nya openly challenged him, stating that she couldn't recall channeling rage through her face when she trained to become the Master of Water. Unsurprisingly, after P.I.X.A.L. informed the team that she had made new upgrades to their vehicles that should allow them to combat the Crystal Warriors, Nya was in full support of fighting them head on than continuing Garmadon's attempts at unlocking Lloyd's Oni form.

Brave But Foolish[]

Nya followed the original four ninja onboard Destiny's Bounty, where she monitored the status of their vehicles as three of the boys began using their new upgrades. Alarmed by their excessive usage, Nya warned them that they would need to shut off their new energy weapons lest they burn out their vehicles' engines - an order that was reluctantly complied with. Once the ninja's vehicle status returned to a normal level, Nya turned her attention over to Garmadon and inquired about the plant he was carrying around. Garmadon then explained to her that the plant was the only bit of green in his life and he hoped that under his care, it would one day thrive and eventually forgive him. Nya surmised that Garmadon was using the plant as a metaphor for his relationship with his son, Lloyd, though he denied such matters when she inquired about them. Nevertheless, Nya emphasized her familiarity with the plant, identifying it as a Baracis ninjagai and that they were known to be quite hardy. However after mentioning that it only required water to be revitalized, Nya suddenly remembered her current loss of powers and walked away sadly to the Bounty's deck.

Steering the Bounty towards the Crystal Island, Nya positioned the ship near its target and fired a pair of grappling cords into the sides of the island with the intention of towing it away from Ninjago City. In response to this attack, the Crystal King unleashed his horde of Dragonides upon the Bounty, two of which attempted to snap up Nya in their jaws. Escaping from the clutches of the Dragonides, Nya made her way to the ship's cannon and began returning fire against the crystalline beasts, lamenting once more her current lack of powers as she attempted to call upon a torrent of water. Moments afterward, Harumi attacked the Bounty with one of the Dragonides, commanding it to attack one of the ship's thrusters and successfully destroying it. Nya braced herself against the mast as the ship rocked from the attack and warned the others onboard to do the same.

Following Wu's defeat to the Crystal King, the latter unleashed a massive bolt of Darkness at the Bounty and heavily damaged the ship, which now began to fall from the skies. Clinging tightly to the mast, Nya called out for Lloyd to pull the air brakes, emphasizing that it was their only chance at survival. Although Lloyd succeeded in doing so, the Bounty had sustained too much damage and cracked in half, with Nya stuck on the bow side as both halves plummeted to the ground. Fortunately, Nya's side of the ship landed slightly slower thanks to the mast remaining mostly intact and catching the winds to slow its descent.

Quittin' Time![]

Nya awoke to find herself pinned beneath the bow's dislodged mast. Realizing the precariousness of her situation, Nya desperately began attempting to free herself. Her grunts, however, were overheard by the Mechanic who then called forth his platoon of Vengestone Guards to crystallize her. Fortunately, Jay's timely arrival managed to destroy several of the approaching warriors and momentarily defeat the Mechanic. In spite of this, Nya was still unable to free herself and many more of the Crystal Warriors were still closing in on them! In her struggle, Nya inadvertently tapped into her slowly returning powers and called upon the water in a nearby fire hydrant, bursting it apart as the water knocked away the approaching warriors. In awe of what just happened, Nya admitted that she was unsure if the hydrant's burst had been her doing, but there was hardly any time to dwell on such matters. Together with Jay's help, Nya finally freed herself from the weight of the mast and embraced her fiancé. Although Nya tried again to call upon the water from the hydrant, nothing happened, and she soon fled with Jay on his motorcycle.

Riding through the city streets, Jay expressed his concern over the ninja's odds of defeating the Crystal army, noting that they were badly outnumbered and desperately required allies. Realizing that Benthomaar now commanded the army of Merlopia, Jay suggested that Nya could possibly reach out to him by communicating with the whales thanks to her returning powers. Although Nya remained doubtful of her abilities, Jay's encouragement was enough for her to be at least willing to give it a try and she asked Jay to bring her to the harbor so that she could make her attempt.

Compatible[]

Nya and Jay continued driving towards the harbor, but briefly stopped by a canal after receiving communications from Wu. As they listened, Nya realized that their allies were taking shelter in the Newspaper warehouse and she briefly attempted to manipulate the water in the canal when Lloyd asked if her powers were returning. After struggling to influence the canal, Nya replied that her powers were slowly returning, but she was unsure if they would be enough for the battle to come.

Distress Calls[]

With the help of Jay, Nya fought her way to the docks. As they encountered a trio of Vengestone Guards, Nya placed a brick onto the acceleration pedal of truck they had commandeered, sending it crashing into the guards and knocking them into the Endless Sea. When Jay then rallied her into calling out towards Merlopia for aid, Nya briefly expressed her doubts about her abilities, noting that her power over water was still weak. When Jay expressed his confidence in her, Nya doubted his sincerity at first but had her fears absolved when Jay reminded her of all the amazing things she had done in the past. With her confidence restored, Nya attempted to reach out to the Merlopians, though remained doubtful of her success in this gesture.

When Wu later contacted her and Jay about their mission, Nya admitted her doubts in the success of her actions and returned to the Resistance's hideout with Jay.

An Issue of Trust[]

Nya and Jay returned to the newspaper warehouse, where they were reunited with the other ninja and Nya briefly shared a hug with Zane. When the group were greeted by Wu, Nya lamented how they were unable to bring back better news regarding their attempts at recruiting allies, which Jay then backed up. She and the others were then ushered inside where Wu went over his discovery of Dragon Form. After Wu explained the concept behind the ability, Nya watched while the other five ninja attempted to achieve it, for Nya's powers had not yet returned to her in full.

After several hours, and with the ninja no closer to achieving Dragon Form, the Resistance were warned by Cyrus Borg that the Crystal King was mobilizing his forces towards the newspaper warehouse! Upon hearing this news, Nya lamented how their elemental powers were of no avail against the Crystal King's army forged from vengestone, though alternative plans were drawn for the battle to come. Once preparations were made, Nya took position outside the newspaper warehouse alongside the rest of the ninja and charged into battle. The final battle had begun.

Dragon Form[]

Nya fought valiantly against the Crystal army as their forces slowly but surely closed in on the surrounded ninja. As their defenses crumbled, Nya tackled Jay out of the way from one of the Dragonides' energy blasts and began slowly backing up against the newspaper warehouse. When all seemed lost, the Crystal army suddenly grinded to a halt as they were attacked by a new party: the Army of Shintaro! Nya and the other ninja then watched in amazement and surprise as more and more of their allies joined the fight, breaking apart the ranks of the Crystal Warriors and buying more breathing time for the beleaguered Resistance. As she watched these events unfold, Nya was surprised in particular by the arrival of the Merlopians and Keepers, confirming to her that her message through the harbor had indeed reached them.

As the allies gathered together, Nya perked up and reminded the ninja of the riddle contained on the scroll; now was the moment where the allies were united! Nya then watched in awe as the original four ninja attempted and achieved Dragon Form and joyously urged them to begin launching their counter-attacks against the Crystal army. As the ninja each singled out and challenged a member of the Council of the Crystal King, Nya found herself squaring off against the Mechanic. After dodging several energy bursts fired from his robo-arm, the Mechanic took a moment to mock Nya for her inability to undertake Dragon Form and suggested that she wasn't a real ninja for that reason. In response, Nya used her steadily returning powers to pull a nearby drain pipe down and atop of the villain. Although she still had the threat of the Mechanic's Crystal Warriors to deal with, she would soon be backed up by Jay who effortlessly shattered the warriors, and Okino who sliced off the Mechanic's robo-arm. When the Mechanic expressed confusion over this new warrior's intervention, Nya giddily shouted out Okino's catchphrase to the Mechanic.

Following the purification of the Weapons of Destruction and the Crystal army's subsequent loss of their powers, Nya partook in the battle on the ground to destroy the remaining Crystal Warriors and celebrated in the wake of their victory on the ground. Unfortunately, celebrations were cut short when all realized that Lloyd and his father had failed to stop the Crystal King. With all eyes turning towards the skies, Nya and the others on the ground could do nothing but watch in terror as the Crystal Island began charging itself to end the battle in favor of Darkness. They have failed.

Roots[]

Nya watched as Wu convinced the ninja to unite and give up their Elemental Powers and Golden Weapons. She later watched with Wu as the Crystal King corrupted all of Ninjago.

After the Crystal King was defeated, Nya, standing next to Wu, asked how that was possible. She then regrouped back with Lloyd and the other ninja and hugged Jay. Later, she aided the ninja in rebuilding the Monastery, speaking to Benthomarr with Jay.

Quest for the Lost Powers

Quest for the Lost Powers[]

After the other ninja left the Monastery to regain their elemental powers, Nya was oftentimes left as the only ninja available to fight off threats to Ninjago with her Samurai X Mech.

Later, Nya went with Jay on vacation to a remote island resort. Not long after their arrival, she noticed Jay's tenseness and suggested for him to go out on a walk by himself to relax, discreetly placing a tracker on his belt as she hugged him. Several hours later, Nya found him and Unagami in one of the forests on the island. She then revealed the tracker and commented that she knew Jay would get lost because his sense of direction was horrible, smiling slyly as the trio returned to their resort.

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 1

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

As time passed, Nya managed to fully recover her Elemental Powers of Water and once again stopped being Samurai X and returned to being the Water Ninja.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

At some point Jay and Nya had a lot of awkward dinners one included when Jay ate a host fern due to thinking it was a side salad and another when he asked for sushi from a fish waiter in the Underwater Kingdom of Merlopia.[15] One day Nya and the other ninja received a message from Master Wu about special training. Jay on the other hand, played video games and his legs got numb so he went out to walk. Wu came out and had them do more Spin Harmony. During the music, Jay offered a dance to Nya and promised to love her forever.[16]

Nya was in the courtyard of the Monastery with the others when The Merge occurred. The ninja and Wu boarded the Bounty and set off into the storm, Nya heard Wu mouthed to himself that he thought he could "pull it off," but that "it happened too soon," however, Nya couldn't hear everything due to the raging loud storm. He then told Nya that only unity can save them, and that they will have no chance if they're separated.[17]Then Nya and her teammates tried to save all the people that was being carried by the storm until the Merge finally broke out with the bounty and the ninja in the storm. Nya was separated from the others during the cataclysm and found herself in an unknown land of the realms now merged. Trying to find the way back to Ninjago she experienced adventures until eventually arriving to the Land of Madness.

Beyond Madness[]

Eventually, Nya stumbled into the Land of Madness where she bore witness to a battle between the native Craglings and a pair of Earth Dragons. Furthermore, Nya discovered that her brother Kai had arrived here as well some time ago and had joined the battle on the side of the Craglings. Nya then learned of the Craglings' predicament, for the dragons were consuming their life energy from their sacred burial grounds, and joined in the battle alongside her brother. One day however, Kai was seemingly killed by the dragons, leaving a distressed Nya to fruitlessly search for him but to no avail.

One day, as the Earth Dragons began another attack on the Cragling Village, Nya stepped up to help defend the village. During the battle, she watched as Lloyd entered on the side of the dragons alongside two teenagers she was unfamiliar with. When the Earth Dragons eventually retreated, Nya attacked the teenagers with a burst of water, though Lloyd dispelled it with his dao. Rushing forward, Nya gasped when she recognized Lloyd, leading to a brief reunion in which Nya lightly criticized her friend's fighting form for rushing into battle without a plan. After Nya cleared up the situation to Lloyd and his students and learned to her dismay that Jay was not with them, Nya brought the group into the village to meet with King Crag-Nor, who invited them all to an authentic Cragling feast of Cragling mud. As they began to eat, Nya told Lloyd and the others the story of how she arrived in the Land of Madness.

At the conclusion of Nya's story, she expressed her desire to avenge her brother against the dragons before the group heard Kai's screams for help and realized that he was still alive. Although initially overjoyed to see her brother again, Nya's joy quickly turned to fury when she realized that Kai had brought the Earth Dragons to the village and she angrily exclaimed that she was going to kill him. Frustrated, Nya dismissed her earlier criticism about rushing into battle without a plan and promptly charged into battle with the Earth Dragons. Unfortunately, as she had not seen, let alone fought alongside, Kai and Lloyd for quite some time, the three of them were uncoordinated in their attacks and were easily routed by the dragons. Sora then reconfigured her mech with a spark from Riyu and offered Nya a platform to provide aerial support with - a suggestion that immediately won Nya's praise. Unfortunately, Sora soon lost control over her powers and her mech collapsed into pieces in mid-air, forcing Kai and Lloyd to halt their attacks to rescue their comrades, with Nya being caught by her brother.

With the ninja momentarily defeated, the Earth Dragons shifted their focus to feeding on the burial grounds, greatly enlarging themselves even more. Riyu then intervened and began channeling his dragon energy into the burial grounds to overload the Earth Dragons, though Nya at first mistook his actions as instead siding with the Earth Dragons. Fortunately with Lloyd's intervention, Riyu was able to overload the Earth Dragons, forcing them to expel all the energy they had consumed back to the Craglings. With the day saved, the Craglings hailed Nya and her friends as their saviors, though Nya correctly pointed out that it was actually Riyu who had saved the day. Shortly thereafter, Nya discussed current matters with Lloyd and Kai while Riyu recuperated, during which Nya expressed her belief that Lloyd was doing a great job as Sora and Arin's teacher.

Writers of Destiny[]

Departing the Land of Madness, Nya expressed lingering confusion about Riyu's Sparks and how exactly they affected Sora's elemental power. The conversation however soon diverted to Arin's self taught Spinjitzu and the MergeQuakes before Lloyd pointed out the sight of floating islands and ivory towers: the ninja had entered Cloud Kingdom. As they edged closer, Kai asked if anyone else could feel a strange rumbling just as a nearby tower began to collapse with two monks trapped on top. Heeding their cries for help, Nya and Kai immediately sprung into action, using Spinjitzu to reach the monks, only for all four to be knocked off the side when the ground shook again. Fortunately, Arin was able to rescue them with his grapple gun, earning him Kai's praise - something Nya pointed out was very rarely given. One of the monks then explained that a beast was destroying everything, prompting Nya to ask "What beast?" just as Kai was struck by one of its tentacles.

Springing into action, Nya and Kai escorted the two monks to safety before attacking the monster with their powers. When it became clear their powers were ineffective against the creature, Nya called for Lloyd to halt on sealing the MergeQuake, pointing out that they could still use it to banish the creature back to its home realm. Nya and Kai then used their Spinjitzu to repeatedy ram the beast's eye, knocking it back bit by bit until it was back into the MergeQuake it had emerged from. Lloyd then sealed the MergeQuake and banished the creature back to its home realm. After the siblings high-fived, Nya and Kai discussed the encounter with Lloyd, noting that Lloyd was correct in his concerns that the MergeQuakes were becoming more frequent and occurring in further places from the original Merge. Kai on the other hand seemed less concerned and suggested for them to speak with a nearby group of Cloud Monks, believing that they were dying to honor the ninja as heroes.

After approaching the Cloud Monks, Nya and the others were greeted by Suetonius, the current Master Writer. Nya remained silent during most of the ensuing conversation, which consisted mostly of Kai and Sora dismissing the beliefs of the resident Cloud Monks, but spoke up when she realized that the monks wrote about anything and everything they believe will happen. She then requested access to the Cloud Kingdom archives to search for information pertaining to the Merge, a request that Suetonius granted. Alongside Lloyd and Kai, Nya then followed their appointed guide, Marcus, to the archives, listening to him talk about ink stains could be washed out of togas along the way. Upon entering the vast archives, Marcus explained the Scroll-Worms to his guests and demonstrated by asking a worm to find information about "Lloyd Garmadon" before prompting for Nya to try. Nya asked the worm for information on "stopping MergeQuakes" and briefly giggled when Kai nicknamed Lloyd the "Master of Green Boogers." However, when the Scroll-Worm returned, it suddenly stopped mid recitation and turned red and hostile alongside the other worms in the archives. All of them then attacked the ninja and Marcus, encasing the four in silk cocoons and suspended them from the ceiling of the archives.

Eventually, Nya was released from the cocoon by Arin and Lloyd, allowing her to join in on the fight taking place outside between Euphrasia, Sora, and three more Tentacled Beasts that had emerged out of a second MergeQuake. Nya joined the battle by hurling a ball of water to blast away a falling brick from crushing the Writers of Destiny. She and Kai then used their Spinjitzu in conjunction with Euphrasia's winds to bounce the third beast back into the MergeQuake before joining their powers alongside those of Lloyd and Euphrasia to seal the MergeQuake. With the day saved, Nya and Kai discussed with Marcus about the Scroll-Worms, reacting with shock and horror when he suggested that someone may have placed a curse upon them to keep certain information hidden. Afterwards, Nya decided to stay in Cloud Kingdom to research the archives while Kai and the others left for the Monastery. Waving goodbye to her brother and her friends, Nya remarked that while it would the work would not be easy without the Scroll-Worms, ninja never quit!

Mindless Beasts[]

Nya continued her research in the Cloud Kingdom Archives and discovered a map to the Temple of the Dragon Cores.

I Will Be the Danger[]

Nya was led by Wu's spirit to the Portal gate housed inside the Cloud Kingdom archives where she was reunited with Kai.

The Calm Inside[]

Inside the Monastery of Imperium, Nya and Kai discussed their current situation and how they were both led here by a strange spirit. The same spirit then led the siblings to a Techno-cocoon alongside the vague instructions of, "It must rise." Nya questioned if what she and her brother saw was merely a trick, but nevertheless decided that the only way to know for sure was to activate the capsule. Eventually, Nya finished up most of the necessary engineering fixes to the capsule and asked her brother to weld some spots for her. She then activated the capsule which, after several kicks from Kai, opened up to reveal that Zane was housed inside of it! Nya revealed to Zane that the Merge had occurred years ago before he started to interface with the Monastery of Imperium and activated it to rise in the streets of the city above. Nya, Kai, and Zane then exited the gates of the Monastery of Imperium, stumbling into a battle raging outside.

The Battle of the Second Monastery[]

Emerging from the Monastery of Imperium, Nya and the other two ninja quickly joined the battle on the side of the dragons. Nya launched herself into a Spinjitzu tornado and attempted to strike at one of the Photacs but was effortlessly knocked back to the ground, much to her surprise. After another failed attack against a Photac, Nya turned to Lloyd and asked him if they had any weaknesses he wasn't sharing, with him responding that they were actually indestructible. Annoyed by the revelation, Nya snidely remarked that it was quite an important detail. Nevertheless, Nya continued to fight back against the Photacs and the Claws of Imperium for as long as she could until Lloyd ordered a hasty retreat into the Monastery of Imperium.

Within the monastery, Nya proposed an alternative to Lloyd's plan: if they couldn't rely on Sora to deactivate the Photacs, perhaps instead they could use the monastery's portal gate to take all the dragons out of Imperium. While this idea was considered the better alternative, Zane noted that more power was needed in order for the gate to transport such a large number of dragons. Eventually, Lloyd encountered a Source Dragon hidden beneath the City of Imperium and after being empowered by his energy, was able to provide the needed power for the gate to function. Nya then called for all her allies to follow the dragons through the gate, returning safely to Ninjago.

A few days later, Nya stepped out into the courtyard of the Monastery of Spinjitzu and gave Lloyd a warm hug when she saw that he had finally woken up. Lloyd then began to talk about his experiences after encountering the Source Dragon, mentioning frightful visions that visibly concerned Nya.

The Temple of the Dragon Cores[]

Nya and the other ninja responded to a MergeQuake in the Crossroads, with Nya riding atop of Jiro. Afterwards, Nya continued researching the scrolls she had taken from the Cloud Kingdom archive, at one point studying in the hanger bay where she handed Lloyd an empty soda can when he was collecting the trash. A few days later, Nya was walking through the halls of the monastery with Sora when they caught sight of Kai and Wyldfyre fighting in Arin's room. Nya and Sora both helped to restrain Wyldfyre just as a very annoyed Zane stepped in and demanded for everyone to follow him to the hanger bay so he could show everyone the data he had been analyzing about the MergeQuakes.

After Zane explained the data, Nya brought up the research she had been conducting and pointed to an island on the map of the Merged Lands. Nya then revealed she had learned of a Temple of the Dragon Cores and how a "Coalescence" had once been prophesized to occur but was stopped, Believing that the temple held the secrets to stopping the MergeQuakes, the ninja set out to find the temple, discovering it within the World Forest. When the ninja approached the entrance to the temple, they found that it had been sealed with a puzzle consisting of multiple runes and three levers. Sora began to propose an approach but was interrupted by Kai, forcing Nya to apologize on his behalf, informing Sora that the older ninja had quite some experience already with ancient temples. Zane then began to analyze the levers and runes, running together every potential combination. After several hours, during which at one point Nya fell asleep but was jolted awake by Sora, Zane declared that he could find no connection between them. Fortunately, the new generation of ninja realized that the levers simply had to all be pulled down at the same time, granting access to the temple.

Entering the temple, the ninja were confronted by a hostile Spirit of the Temple. In the fight that ensued, Nya attempted to attack the spirit with Spinjitzu but phased through the incorporeal being and slammed into a wall. Nya's further attempt at stabbing the Spirit with her spear was met with similar futility and she received a punch across the room for her trouble. Landing beside Wyldfyre, Nya overheard the younger girl mention having armpit parasites, horrifying and alarming Nya. Shortly afterwards, Lloyd managed to calm down the Spirit by reassembling the alter and the grateful Spirit then regaled to the ninja a tale about the Dragon Cores and the Coalescence, during which Nya realized that the term referred to the Merge.

Gangs of the Sea[]

Inside the hanger bay, Nya laid out a map of the Merged Realms as the ninja planned their search for the Dragon Cores. Lloyd proposed splitting into two teams, and Nya immediately stated that she would take Sora and Riyu. The pair were then approached by "Sora" the dragon and Nya suggested that she could come too. However, Nya's nonchalant usage of the name "Sora" confused everyone present with regards to who exactly Nya was referring to, greatly irritating her. After some back and forth clarifying, Nya exasperatedly groaned that the similar names were going to be problem.

Wyldly Inappropriate[]

Riding atop of Jiro, Nya accompanied Sora, Riyu, and "Sora" the dragon to the Pinnacle of Crystals, only to discover that the Yellow Dragon Core was missing from its resting place.

The Last Djinn[]

With the yellow dragon core missing, Nya, Sora, and Riyu sought out an Ancient tomb, hoping to use a set of Seeker Stones borrowed from the Writers of Destiny to direct them to the missing core. Almost immediately upon entering, the three survived the first trap where they were shot at with spears. As they continued through the tomb, Sora started to cynically speak about her spate of bad luck and stressed that her existence was a black cloud. In response, Nya urged Sora to avoid focusing on the negatives and encouraged her to never lose hope. Nya's words of encouragement however were cut short when she stepped on a slightly raised tile and dropped the three of them down a chamber holding a pool of acid. Fortunately, Nya spotted a safe ledge and propelled herself forward with jets of water before catching Sora and Riyu.

Sora commented on the acid pit, exclaiming that this was exactly what she had predicted, but Nya corrected her, pointing out that the stones didn't fall into the acid. Nya once again emphasized the importance of never giving up or losing hope, noting that without hope, nothing can go right. Sora asked if it's a saying from Wu, but Nya clarified that it's her own, inspired by Wu's teachings beyond fighting. The trio soon entered the tomb's burial vault where Nya explained the Djinn and Djinjago to Sora. Approaching the alter, Nya attempted to arrange the Seeker Stones correctly, but inadvertently unleashed a curse upon herself and Sora.

Leaving the tomb, Nya and Sora met up with "Sora" and Jiro outside. "Sora" seemed troubled and pointed to symbols on Nya and Sora's hands just as two Howlers emerged from the tomb and attacked the group. Unable to defeat the spirits in combat, Nya and the others were forced to flee on the dragons, eventually discovering a sanctum hidden within a cave. There, the group encountered Arrakore, the last Djinn. Nya seemed a bit more uneasy than her allies about the Djinn's presence, noting that Djinjago was destroyed. Arrakore glumly affirmed Nya's comment but revealed he survived due to being in another realm at the time of its destruction alongside "Sora," whose real name was revealed to be "Zanth." When Arrakore learned of the curse placed upon Nya and Sora and demanded to know if either had attempted to use Seeker Stones without proper guidance, Nya sheepishly answered that it was a possibility, much to Arrakore's chagrin. Nevertheless, Nya believed that they had lost the Howlers and there was no chance of being found again until Arrakore clarified the nature of the Howlers as a curse and that therefore, there was a one hundred percent chance the Howlers would continue finding Nya and Sora until both of them were killed.

Shortly thereafter, the Howlers arrived at the sanctum, forcing everyone inside to fight back. Unfortunately, in spite of everyone's best efforts, Nya was forced to admit that the Howlers were unstoppable while Sora complained about Arrakore's attitude. Midst comment, Sora realized that Arrakore's attitude was almost no different than her own and she turned to Nya, asking if the latter felt the same way; Nya declined to comment however. Sora then encouraged Arrakore into rediscovering his hope and Nya wished for the Howlers to be gone, finally dispelling them and lifting the curse.

When Arrakore awoke, Nya and Sora thanked him for his help and Nya suggested that perhaps in time, as Arrakore's strength and magic returned, he may one day restore the entirety of Djinjago. The group then celebrated their victory over the Howlers with feasting and music.

They Call It Doom[]

The next day, Nya and Sora thanked Arrakore again for the lovely evening. Arrakore then expressed his gratitude by granting Nya's wish to find the missing dragon core, creating a magical compass that would direct them to its location. Following the compass, Nya and her allies made their way to the bizarre Land of Lost Things. After commenting on the strangeness of the place, Nya and Sora spotted two kids and tried to flag them down for information. Unfortunately, the kids ran off, forcing the two to give chase until they were attacked by a large stone golem who declared that no one was going to hurt the kids. The fight that followed however was brief and ended when the golem recognized Nya; for her part however, Nya was unsure if the golem truly was her old friend Cole.

Land of Lost Things[]

Nya continued to doubt the golem's identity as Cole up until the stones fell away, revealing the Earth Ninja within. Overjoyed to see her friend, Nya immediately ran up and embraced him with a hug, exclaiming that she wasn't sure she'd ever see him again. Nya then introduced Cole to Sora and Riyu while Cole introduced her to the Finders. Their conversation however, was cut short by the arrival of the Hoarder, who attacked them. The group fled to a giant noodle cup, where Nya first expressed a desire to fight the Hoarder until Cole clarified that he and the Finders have already tried, and every time the Hoarder simply rebuilds itself stronger than before. Cole then created an escape tunnel for everyone to use and Geo used his own powers to fuse the cup with the Hoarder's hand.

The ninja and the Finders regrouped with Zanth and Jiro and made their way to the Rookery. Along the way, they admired Geo's sculptures and Nya insisted to Sora that her powers were her own while remarking that the Merge must have created a slew of new elemental powers. As they entered the Rookery, Cole told Sora and Nya about the Finders, who ended up in the Land of Lost Things after running away from home. Cole then showed off a machine used by the Finders to keep the Hoarder at bay, with its power source being the yellow Dragon Core! Nya attempted to take the core but was stopped by Cole who protested that if the core was removed, the machine would stop, and the Hoarder would eat him and the Finders. In response, Nya proposed to take Cole and the Finders back the monastery but learned that the Finders were unable to leave the Land of Lost Things. Sora proposed reconfiguring the machine with a different power source so they can take the yellow Dragon Core and gave Nya the schematics she just drew up. Impressed, Nya volunteered for her, Cole, and Jiro to find the remaining parts that were needed for Sora's plan.

As they searched for the missing parts, Nya and Cole noted that they had a lot of stories to share with one another but soon ran into a problem when they encountered several Imperium Drones and the Hoarder. Nya fought off the drones harassing Jiro and the trio flew back to the Rookery where they witnessed Dr. LaRow stealing the yellow Dragon Core from the Rookery. Nya and Jiro gave chase but ultimately failed to stop Dr. LaRow from escaping. When she returned to the Rookery, Nya was surprised to see that the Hoarder had seemingly been destroyed by the others, remarking that she must have missed a lot.

Absolute Power[]

The next day, Nya, Sora, and Cole discussed their next steps, deciding that they would have to infiltrate the City of Imperium to retrieve the dragon core taken by Dr. LaRow. Sora began creating a set of weaponized armor for Jiro and Nya complimented the girl on how far she had improved in controlling her powers. Cole then confided in Nya that Wu's voice came to him last night and was directing him towards an unknown goal. Understanding her friend's situation, Nya hugged Cole and encouraged him to follow Wu's voice. Nya then departed for Imperium alongside Sora and Riyu, leaving Cole to continue his journey alone.

We Are All Dragons[]

Approaching the City of Imperium, Nya admitted to Sora that while it was rotten to its core, it did look absolutely perfect from the outside. When Sora brought up her parents again, Nya suggested that they could try talking to them when things settled down, though Sora refused to even entertain such an idea, dismissing it as an impossibility. Nya and Jiro then utilized the guns on the latter's new armor to punch through the city's electro barrier and joined in on the fight on the ground, slamming Empress Beatrix and her Empress Mech to the ground.

As the fight progressed, Jiro proposed for himself and Zanth to keep the empress busy while the others escaped. The Teen Resistance Force then led the ninja to their secret headquarters beneath the city, where Nya and Zane recognized parts of the Monastery of Imperium. Percival explained how Beatrix had ordered the monastery's destruction following the battle that had taken place outside some time ago, leading Nya to recognize why parts of the monastery's portal gate were found in the Land of Lost Things.

The ninja then split into three teams, with Nya accompanying Zane and Lloyd to the Imperium Palace to retrieve the two Dragon Cores that were in Beatrix's possession. By nightfall, the three still had yet to reach the palace and were ambushed again by the Good Empress - greatly impressing Nya. Although the three tried to fight her off, Beatrix's mech proved to be far too powerful. After the three were slammed against the side of a building, Sora's broadcast came through, exposing Beatrix's lies and turning the citizens of Imperium against her. With the way now clear, Nya, Zane, and Lloyd finally reached the palace gates but still faced a massive amount of guards. Before any of them could do anything further, the guards were notified that the Imperium Armory had been attacked, drawing all of them away much to Nya's surprise. However, Beatrix ambushed the three once more, now brandishing her MergeQuake weapon powered by the Dragon Cores the ninja had been seeking.

The Power Within[]

Facing the crazed Empress, Nya and the other two tried to talk her out of firing the MergeQuake weapon, with Nya warning that its use would create a MergeQuake storm that would destroy all of reality. Beatrix however ignored the warnings, branding them as lies before recklessly unleashing rifts across the entire city. Unable to stop her, Nya, Lloyd, and Zane were forced to retreat and regroup with the other ninja before attempting another attack against the Empress.
